articles.title: WNBA gives Cheryl Reeve another award after playoff collapse and years of outspoken left-wing politics

paras.en: The WNBA has another award for Cheryl Reeve. This one comes from the people who run the teams, and that makes it worth examining what, exactly, they are celebrating.

The league announced Monday that the Minnesota Lynx head coach and president of basketball operations won Basketball Executive of the Year for the third time, tying the Atlanta Dream's Dan Padover for the most selections in the award's history.

The announcement comes less than two weeks after the top-seeded Lynx were swept out of the first round of the playoffs by the eighth-seeded New York Liberty, who were subsequently swept in the semifinals by the Dream.
Reeve appeared on 13 ballots, ahead of Padover's 11 and Golden State's Ohemaa Nyanin's eight. Each of the WNBA's 15 teams had an executive on the voting panel, and voters couldn't select themselves.
That's a substantial endorsement of Reeve from her peers and it also amounts to tacit approval of the way one of the league's most outspoken left-wing figures represents her franchise.

An executive helps establish what an organization stands for, and Reeve has made her politics a major part of that job. She consistently uses her WNBA platform to attack the motives of people who believe women's sports should be reserved for females.
Her colleagues have now chosen to celebrate her leadership. That deserves scrutiny beyond a list of successful transactions.
Dallas made Reeve's Olivia Miles decision awfully easy

The league's announcement highlighted Reeve's selection of Olivia Miles with the No. 2 pick in the 2026 WNBA Draft. Miles went on to become the unanimous Rookie of the Year and set the league's rookie scoring record with 790 points.
An excellent addition, obviously. But let's remember how Miles became available.
The Dallas Wings could have (and should have) taken Miles, but elected to draft Paige Bueckers' girlfriend, Azzi Fudd, with the No. 1 pick instead.
The Wings publicly praised Fudd's shooting. But pretending that their selection of Fudd was based entirely on her basketball skills is foolish.

Miles averaged 19.8 points, 6.0 assists and 4.7 rebounds as a rookie. Fudd averaged 13.1 points, 1.8 assists and 1.7 rebounds. Miles produced those numbers while playing slightly fewer minutes per game, shot better from the field and finished second in MVP voting.
Reeve should probably send the Wings a thank-you note.

In April 2024, the Chicago Sky moved from No. 8 to No. 7 and acquired the rights to Nikolina Milić. Minnesota received Sika Koné, a 2025 second-round pick and the right to swap first-round picks with Chicago in 2026, along with the No. 8 selection.
Chicago used No. 7 on Angel Reese. At the time of the deal, Minnesota was coming off a 19-21 season and Chicago an 18-22 season.

In April 2025, Minnesota sent Chicago the No. 11 pick, which the Sky used on Hailey Van Lith, for Chicago's 2026 first-rounder outright. That deal canceled the earlier swap and allowed Minnesota to keep its own 2026 first-round pick, too.
Reeve deserves credit for those trades. Once Dallas passed on Miles, though, the choice at No. 2 was awfully easy.
Reeve also signed Natasha Howard, who started all 44 games and earned an All-Star starting spot. Minnesota finished 33-11 and earned the No. 1 playoff seed.
Dallas did Reeve an enormous favor, and the Lynx benefited.
Reeve's team couldn't win a playoff game
For all those advantages, what did the Lynx do in the playoffs?
Minnesota became the first No. 1 seed in WNBA history to be eliminated by a No. 8 seed, and New York did it in a sweep.

The Lynx had the unanimous Rookie of the Year (who also finished second in MVP voting). And while Napheesa Collier, one of the league’s best players, missed time during the regular season, she played in both playoff games.
Minnesota lost both of those games by 16 points, including a 91-75 defeat at home in Game 1.
Reeve's four championships are part of her record. So is the fact that the most recent one came in 2017. In the nine seasons since, Minnesota has reached the Finals once, losing to New York in 2024.
During that same stretch, Reeve has collected three Coach of the Year awards and all three of her Executive of the Year awards.
Six individual awards. Zero championships.
If Reeve gets the credit for both building the roster and coaching it, she can answer for what that team did in the playoffs, too.
An executive sets the tone for the franchise
Reeve already won her fifth Coach of the Year award two weeks ago. With Monday's announcement, she became the first person to win Coach of the Year and Executive of the Year in the same season twice.

For me, evaluating an executive means evaluating leadership. If an executive repeatedly uses the team's platform to make political statements, those statements belong in the discussion of how she represents the organization.
Reeve wore a "Trans Kids Belong" shirt on the sideline against the Indiana Fever shortly after Sophie Cunningham's comments about wanting to protect women's sports went public.
After Minnesota's Sept. 24 regular-season finale, Reeve characterized the controversy involving male participation in women's sports as an attack on what she called the "transgender community."
"They don't want transgender people to exist," Reeve said.
That's an ugly accusation to make about people whose position is that girls and women deserve their own athletic category.
And it came from the person who both coaches the Lynx and oversees their basketball operations. Her public conduct carries the authority of both positions.
By honoring Reeve as the year's outstanding basketball executive, her peers are publicly holding up her leadership as an example. Her political conduct is part of that leadership.
The same people entrusted with running women's basketball teams are applauding a leader who talks openly about allowing males to compete in women's sports and share their locker rooms.
That says a lot about what the WNBA's decision-makers will celebrate.

articles.title: Dodgers dynasty on the brink after the Milwaukee BABIP machine dials up another win for Brewers

paras.en: Game 2 of the National League Championship Series on Monday afternoon was a must-win for the Los Angeles Dodgers.

Despite widespread perception that the Dodgers are the unbeatable superteam, it was Milwaukee, the team that finished with the best record in the league, that played essentially flawless baseball in a Game 1 win. While Jacob Misiorowski wasn't his typically dominant self, every time Los Angeles had an opportunity to break the game open, "The Miz" and his team's defense clamped down.

Already up a run in the second inning, the Dodgers had the bases loaded with postseason star Kike Hernandez at the plate. Once again, the Brewers defense was perfectly positioned to turn the inning-ending double play. After Milwaukee's offense scratched across two runs against Tarik Skubal, their bullpen continued its remarkable run of success, going 4.2 scoreless innings to secure the win.

Still, the Dodgers felt good about their chances with Yoshinobu Yamamoto, postseason hero from 2025, starting in Game 2 against Logan Henderson. Yet for all the hype about LA's remarkable rotation, the Milwaukee BABIP (batting average on balls in play) machine once again kicked into high gear to secure a massive 2-0 series lead and put the Dodgers' three-peat hopes on life support with a 7-4 win.

LA jumped out to an early lead thanks to some uncharacteristic sloppiness from the Brewers. Mookie Betts walked, Freddie Freeman moved him to second, and he took third on a wild pitch from starter Logan Henderson. Teoscar Hernandez knocked him in with a sacrifice fly, and the Dodgers had a 1-0 lead without a hit. Sure enough though, Milwaukee immediately tied it in the bottom of the first.

The Dodgers missed an opportunity to challenge an obvious missed strike three call on Brice Turang, who then doubled and scored on a patented Brewers bloop single. William Contreras stuck his bat out with one hand, somehow making contact with Yamamoto's pitch to dump it into left field. It wouldn't be the last time.

The third inning was a near-repeat. LA mounted a quick rally on back-to-back singles from Tommy Edman and Mookie Betts. Sal Frelick robbed Freddie Freeman of a double with a nice running catch in the right center field gap, but an error on a pickoff attempt at first base brought Edman in to score. But the Brewers, knowing that the Dodgers' greatest weakness is having an opportunity to score runs, had them right where they wanted them. Easy outs from Teoscar Hernandez and Shohei Ohtani ended the "threat," and Milwaukee answered right back in the bottom of the inning.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: David Hamilton poked another bloop single, stole second, and yet again, Brice Turang reached base on a missed strike three that went unchallenged by catcher Will Smith. Jake Bauers, one of the worst hitters in baseball before putting on a Milwaukee uniform, worked a walk after a lengthy at bat against Yamamoto, and Christian Yelich made him pay for it with a single to center.

After all this playoff heroics in 2025, Yamamoto went just 2.2 innings, allowing four hits and three runs. Missed challenges, bloop singles, exceptionally well-timed line drives from below average hitters, the ideal Milwaukee offensive outing.

Now trailing 3-2, the Dodgers "fought" back in the fifth. Kyle Tucker led off with a double, before a throwing error from Henderson on a Tommy Edman bunt let him score and sent Edman to second. A grounder and sac fly gave LA a 4-3 lead, once again without getting a hit with runners in scoring position.
Sure enough, William Contreras immediately tied it in the bottom of the inning with a mammoth homer to left-center.

The Brewers bullpen, which is apparently unhittable, put up another scoreless inning, before the Milwaukee superteam once again kicked into high gear in the bottom of the sixth. Hamilton reached on a hit by pitch, advanced to second after a poor pickoff attempt, went to third on a Jackson Chourio grounder, and scored on yet another end of the bat blooper from Contreras.

Again, the Brewers' relief pitchers proved to be the single greatest pitching unit ever assembled, extending their streak to nearly 29 innings with just one run allowed. Monday was the first time in playoff history that a team's bullpen went over five innings in a postseason game without giving up a baserunner. JoJo Romero, Abner Uribe, Trevor Megill, Aaron Ashby, DL Hall...that's the real superteam, and it cost about $17 to build it.

The BABIP continued into the eighth, as David Hamilton crushed a 73mph single to right field, stole second, and scored on yet another obliterated 71mph single from Brice Turang. That hit pushed the Brewers to 5-12 with RISP.
Jake Bauers added on with yet another 73mph bloop single to make Milwaukee 6-13 with RISP.

Somehow, Milwaukee has perfected the art of running into singles on poorly hit balls in play. Some might say it's a skill, but decades of data and information have told us it isn't. Players and teams with poor exit velocities don't outperform with batting average on balls in play, in fact, it's the opposite.
The league leaders in hard hit percentage this season were, in order:

All five had BABIPs at or above league average, Wood and De La Cruz were .344 and .359, respectively. Jac Caglianone was eighth in hard hit percentage and second in baseball in BABIP. Hitting the ball hard is a skill, soft contact isn't. Yet the Brewers have three hitters in the top seven in BABIP anyway.

Does it matter that Milwaukee has likely been lucky this season? No, not at all. A playoff series is the epitome of a small sample size, and reversion to the mean doesn't have to happen over five-to-seven games. Contreras could hit 17 straight bloopers off the end of the bat, because that's baseball. Which is why predictions of a guaranteed Dodgers' World Series win because of their talent were always so laughable.

Milwaukee had more hits with runners in scoring position in this game, not one hit hard, than the Dodgers have all postseason. And they're going back to LA with a 2-0 series lead and overwhelming likelihood of advancing to the World Series. The gaps between teams in baseball are so small that a bounce here or there, a team's ability to magically ensure that 71mph bloopers are placed perfectly, despite there being no ability to do that, can change a playoff series. David Hamilton, who is objectively an awful baseball player, reached base four times and scored two runs. Shohei Ohtani, the best player in the history of baseball, was useless. That's not unusual or unexpected, it's part of the sport. Which is why it's impossible for one team to guarantee themselves anything.

paras.en: Will this matter to the "ruining baseball" crowd? Of course not, reality never does.

articles.title: ABC accuses FCC of trying to 'inflict maximal coercive pressure' with probe against network

paras.en: Disney and ABC accused the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on Monday of using the license renewal process to circumvent "judicial review" and inflict "maximal coercive pressure" against the network and company.

Disney originally sued the FCC in August over what it claimed was a "retaliatory campaign against ABC" regarding the agency's early broadcast license renewal proceedings for eight ABC-owned stations earlier this year. The stations, according to the FCC, must demonstrate they are operating in the public interest as the agency investigates diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) practices.

However, in Disney's latest filing, the company asserted that the FCC could have used "a number of different tools" to investigate Disney and ABC's DEI practices that did not involve forcing stations to renew their licenses years ahead of schedule, suggesting it was done to avoid legal scrutiny.

"These are not merely 'theoretical' tools ... they have been used by the agency for decades," the filing read. "Yet the agency tried none of those less intrusive tools here, instead taking the unprecedented step of calling for early license renewal of all eight ABC-owned stations at once. Defendants’ own admissions leave no doubt as to why — Defendants sought to inflict maximal coercive pressure on the media company whose speech the Administration sought to curb, while deliberately evading judicial review."
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Disney cited a court hearing last week in which the FCC was instructed to provide a supplemental filing on alternative methods the agency could have used. During the hearing, the FCC suggested that additional procedures would have required federal court enforcement.

"That Defendants openly describe judicial review as an obstacle demonstrates what Plaintiffs have been saying all along: shielding their unconstitutional campaign against ABC from judicial review is part of Defendants’ retaliatory strategy," the filing read.
In a comment to Fox News Digital, FCC spokesperson Adam Jackman dismissed the latest filing as an effort to block the FCC in court procedures.

"Disney’s latest filing only confirms that they’ve filed a meritless case in the wrong court at the wrong time," Jackman said. "They want a district court to prevent the FCC from even considering whether Disney has complied with its longstanding obligations as a broadcaster. The law does not allow that. The FCC will continue to hold broadcasters accountable to their regulatory obligations."
Fox News Digital also reached out to ABC and Disney for comment but did not immediately receive a response.

Disney and ABC have repeatedly attacked the FCC's probes and investigations into the company as a form of retaliation over programs and hosts that are critical of President Donald Trump, such as late-night host Jimmy Kimmel.

In addition to the license renewal proceedings, the FCC has launched a probe into the ABC daytime talk show "The View" based on the agency's demand that broadcast stations adhere to the equal opportunity requirement stating opposing political candidates receive equal time. Disney has maintained that "The View" is a "bona fide news" program exempted from the rule.

articles.title: Body found in stockyard trough confirmed to be missing 73-year-old Yvonne Whear
articles.author: Joe Hinchliffe in Tweed Heads

paras.en: New South Wales police say a decomposed body found in a stockyard dip last week was missing woman Yvonne Whear, who vanished eight months ago after last being seen in Murwillumbah.
Police said a week ago that a partially submerged body believed to be a woman had been discovered in a remote stockyard in Terragon near Murwillumbah.

The badly decomposed body was found partially submerged in a disused stock dip, a large trough-type structure used to bathe livestock in anti-parasite solutions. Police on Tuesday confirmed it was Whear and her death was being treated as a homicide.
“As a result of the forensic examinations that were conducted … we are satisfied that Yvonne has been murdered,” Acting Supt Matt Zimmer said on Tuesday.
He said investigators were determined to find those responsible.
“Yvonne was a mother, grandmother, a great grandmother and a person who was clearly loved by those around her.
“While we can now provide some answers to her family, there are still significant questions about what happened to her and how she came to be where she was found.
“Someone knows what happened to Yvonne. Whether you have previously spoken to police or have information you have not yet shared, we need you to come forward.”
In mid-September, police divers found her car in the Rous River in Dulguigan – a short distance from her home.
“Several personal items, believed to belong to Yvonne, were also recovered,” police said at the time.
Zimmer was asked on Tuesday if Whear’s killer could have been picked up after dumping her car in the river.
“That’s certainly one of the possibilities we’re exploring – that there could have been more than one person [involved],” he said.

Whear was last seen on CCTV on 19 February buying orange juice and putting $50 credit on her phone at the Shell service station in Murwillumbah, before she drove through cane fields to her hobby farm at the hamlet of Dungay.
She had lived there for 23 years with a menagerie of animals she cared for. Whear was due to appear in the NSW Civil and Administrative Tribunal over a property dispute a week after she vanished.
There is no suggestion her disappearance is related to the proceedings and no one involved is accused of wrongdoing.

At 8.30pm on 19 February, a member of the public reported seeing her car, a gold Ford Escape wagon, parked in the dark without lights, on Dungay Creek Road, less than a kilometre from where she lived.
Her daughter Gillian Hallac said that she never drove at night if she could help it.

Whear’s boots and hat that she had been wearing in the CCTV footage were still in her house, she had food in the slow cooker, her usual shoes were at the door. Her clothes were folded on her bed ready for the next day. Her family said she would never leave her animals.
Her phone last pinged at 10am the next day from a tower that put her mobile in the area where her car was subsequently found.
Zimmer said Whear’s family was “devastated” by the homicide.
“They described this loss as unimaginable grief,” he told reporters on Tuesday.
The superintendent said her killing had rocked the “very tight knit community” in which she lived.
“Yvonne was a 73-year-old woman with no criminal history. A mother of three. A grandmother of 10. A great grandmother of one. She was a cherished friend and very valued member of that community.”
NSW police set up a strike force to investigate. Specialist police were conducting forensic testing and again searching Whear’s property.
Zimmer said police were not drawing links to other cases.
“At this point in time, there’s no information and no evidence to indicate there’s any involvement of a serial offender,” he said.
“Obviously, this incident has caused the community a lot of alarm. It’s causing distress. But on the information that we have, there’s no broader threat to the community.”
Zimmer said police were exploring possible motives but he would not comment on whether investigators had any suspects.
He described the cattle dip as a concrete structure 15 metres long and about 1.8 metres deep off an “overgrown” fire trail.
“That particular location is very isolated,” he said. “It’s about 300 metres down an overgrown fire trail off Kyogle Road there.”
Whear’s remains were found by two trail bike riders. Zimmer said the area was used by bikers and also near a swimming hole.
Asked if the person who dumped Whear’s body would have to have known the area, he replied: “That’s one of our lines of investigation.”
Zimmer said police were investigating how long Whear’s remains had been in the cattle dip.
“We’re very interested in that location,” he said on Tuesday. “In particular, people that may have frequented that location between 19 February and when the body was located last Monday.”

articles.title: IMF warns global economy ‘could soon test the limits of resilience’
articles.author: Heather Stewart in Bangkok

paras.en: The global economy “could soon test the limits of resilience”, as emergency oil stocks run low and government budgets become overstretched, the International Monetary Fund has warned.
In its twice-yearly World Economic Outlook, the IMF said global growth had withstood the Middle East conflict better than feared over the past six months.
It said the rerouting of oil supplies away from the strait of Hormuz, and the release of strategic energy stocks, had helped to contain the impact on oil prices from the US-Iran war.

However, it warned that emergency stocks are now depleted, and high debt levels and deficits in many countries could leave governments with little capacity to protect consumers from any future jump in prices.

“Without shoring up supply capacity and replenishing policy buffers, the global economy could soon test the limits of resilience,” it said. “Inventories in energy markets are dwindling and additional geopolitical shocks could still transmit rapidly through prices and supply disruptions.”

The International Energy Agency announced the largest-ever emergency releases of oil stocks on to the market in March this year, and promised to accelerate it after a meeting of oil ministers last month.
But in a sign of the system’s vulnerability, the US strategic petroleum reserve was recently reported to have fallen to its lowest level since 1982.

Last week, Donald Trump agreed a deal with Vladimir Putin to temporarily lift sanctions on US imports of Russian diesel in an attempt to bring down prices at the pumps, which analysts said would have little “meaningful” effect.

The World Economic Report was published on Tuesday in Bangkok, where the IMF and World Bank are holding their annual meetings this week, with finance ministers and central bankers scheduled to attend.

Ahead of the gathering, the IMF managing director, Kristalina Georgieva, urged governments to tighten their belts, amid rising global debt levels. “We cannot keep delaying necessary policy action – you have the tools, now have the wisdom to use them,” she said.
In the report, the IMF revised up its forecast for global economic growth this year marginally, to 3.1% – against 3% in its last update in July. Next year’s forecast is unchanged, at 3.4%.
US growth remains unchanged at 2.3% this year and revised up to the same pace, 2.3%, for 2027 – from 2.2% at the last update.

The IMF predicted GDP growth of 1.3% for the UK this year – up 0.3 percentage points from its most recent update in July – in welcome news for the chancellor, John Healey, who is set to arrive in Bangkok later this week.

However, the IMF also warned that prolonged high oil prices and rising interest rates meant growth was likely to “edge down” in 2027, “as higher energy prices and long-term interest rates weigh on consumption and investment”. It cut its UK growth forecast for next year modestly to 1.2%, from 1.3%.

However, the IMF warned that “risks are skewed to the downside” for the global economy. In particular, it pointed to the threat of “a prolonged stalemate or further escalation in the Middle East”, which would lead to higher energy and food prices.
“Further disruptions to energy infrastructure, cyber-attacks, or extreme weather events could amplify these effects,” the IMF added.
Trump has continued to insist that he could launch another wave of attacks on Iran in the coming weeks, with little sign of a peace agreement being negotiated.
The persistence of elevated oil prices means the spike in inflation is now expected to last longer than previously forecast.
Global inflation is expected to be 4.7% this year – the same level as forecast in July – and to decline to 4.1% in 2027 – up from 4% in the last update.

The IMF urged the world’s central banks not to overreact to short-term jumps in inflation, but to be ready to respond quickly if it appears to be becoming entrenched. “With economic conditions in flux, agility is at a premium,” it said.
As well as fresh turmoil in energy markets, the IMF pointed to the continuing risk to the global economy of an AI-driven market crash.

articles.title: ‘Clear and present danger’: fuel prices could rise by 30c a litre across Australia under IMF scenario
articles.author: Patrick Commins Economics editor

paras.en: An International Monetary Fund scenario where global oil prices jump to $US130 a barrel over coming months could push Australian petrol prices up by another 30 cents and pile pressure on the Reserve Bank to hike interest rates, economists say.

In its latest World Economic Outlook, the IMF modelled the impact on global growth and inflation from a worsening Middle East crisis that extended into next year, highlighting the “clear and present danger” to a resilient global economy from turmoil in commodity and bond markets.
The Washington-based institution did not publish the impact on Australia from a hypothetical $US30 jump in the price of crude oil, from over $US106 a barrel now.

The IMF described a scenario where “the conflict persists through the end of June 2027, keeping the straits of Hormuz and Bab el Mandeb largely closed to commercial shipping, extending damages to oil infrastructures in the region, and delaying the recovery in oil supply to the end of 2027”.
“With limited scope for further inventory drawdown, oil prices reach $US130 from the fourth quarter of 2026 to the first quarter of 2027.”
Unleaded petrol prices in the major east coast cities have pushed above $2.40 a litre in recent days and towards six-month highs, while diesel prices have eased but remain high at about $2.80.

Using a rule of thumb that every $US10 rise in global oil prices leads to a 10c price rise at the bowser, a $US30 oil price increase could drive unleaded petrol towards $2.70 and the highest since the start of the war over seven months ago.

Economists told Guardian Australia that such a move could leave inflation more than 1 percentage higher than expected by the end of the year, adding to households’ cost of living woes and dragging on growth.
Jonathan Kearns, the chief economist at Challenger, said “the reality” was that the RBA – alongside other central banks – would have to respond to higher fuel costs with higher interest rates.
“The question is how much higher,” Kearns said.

The RBA delivered a fourth interest rate hike last month. Minutes from that meeting released on Tuesday showed that board members discussed how “the Middle East conflict had escalated and oil prices were substantially above the level assumed in the August forecasts”.
“More broadly, members noted that global cost pressures appeared to be building. Some of this came from the indirect effects of higher oil prices,” the minutes read.
Jonathan McMenamin, head of economic forecasts at Barrenjoey, said he expected inflation to lift to 4.2% in the year to September, against 4% in August.
McMenamin said that every 10% rise in fuel prices directly added 0.33 percentage points to headline inflation.
The RBA’s prediction of a fall in headline inflation to 3.6% by the end of the year is based on the Brent crude price falling to $US81.

Should global oil prices instead push towards $US1.30, as per the IMF scenario (and assuming each $US10 oil price increase leads to a 10c rise in fuel prices), inflation could instead still be as high as 4.5% in late 2026.

But McMenamin was less convinced the RBA would have to respond with higher interest rates, saying the central bank has been mostly responding to underlying price pressures related to domestic capacity constraints, rather than overseas factors.

articles.title: Immigration agents search congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home

paras.en: US immigration agents have searched the home of Minnesota Representative Ilhan Omar as part of a criminal investigation.
paras.zh: 作为刑事调查的一部分，美国移民代理人搜查了明尼苏达州众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔（ Ilhan Omar ）的住所。

paras.en: Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) agents "executed a judicially authorised search warrant" for the property in the Washington DC area, a US justice department spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 美国司法部发言人表示，国土安全调查局（ HSI ）特工对华盛顿特区地区的房产“执行了司法授权的搜查令”。

paras.en: The search "is part of an ongoing federal criminal investigation", the spokesperson said, but no further details were given. The US Congress is currently out of session and it is unclear if Omar was at the home.
paras.zh: 发言人说，这次搜查“是正在进行的联邦刑事调查的一部分” ，但没有提供进一步的细节。美国国会目前正在休会，目前尚不清楚奥马尔是否在家。

paras.en: Omar, a Democrat and outspoken critic of President Donald Trump, described the search on social media as "an attempt to target political enemies and weaponize federal law enforcement".
paras.zh: 奥马尔是民主党人，也是唐纳德特朗普总统的直言不讳的批评者，他将社交媒体上的搜索描述为“试图瞄准政治敌人并将联邦执法武器化”。

paras.en: "For ten years, Trump has targeted me with baseless lies and smear campaigns," Omar said in the post.
paras.zh: “十年来，特朗普一直以毫无根据的谎言和诽谤运动瞄准我，”奥马尔在帖子中说。

paras.en: "This is just the latest escalation in his campaign of political intimidation. I will not be silenced."
paras.zh: “这只是他政治恐吓运动的最新升级。我不会沉默的。”

paras.en: Speaking to reporters on Monday, Trump said he had "nothing to do" with the justice department's investigation into Omar, while describing her as a "complainer" and a "terrible person".
paras.zh: 特朗普周一在接受记者采访时表示，他与司法部对奥马尔的调查“无关” ，同时将她描述为“投诉者”和“可怕的人”。

paras.en: The Republican president said of the Somali-born congresswoman: "She comes from a country that is a non-country.
paras.zh: 这位共和党总统谈到这位索马里出生的女议员时说： “她来自一个非国家的国家。

paras.en: "And then she comes over here and she complains about our Constitution."
paras.zh: “然后她来到这里，抱怨我们的宪法。”

paras.en: Omar's communications director, Jacklyn Rogers, called Monday morning's raid "an outrageous abuse of power" by the Trump administration, and said the congresswoman "has done nothing wrong".
paras.zh: 奥马尔的通讯总监杰克林·罗杰斯（ Jacklyn Rogers ）称特朗普政府周一早上的突袭“滥用权力” ，并表示这位女议员“没有做错任何事”。

paras.en: The nature of the criminal investigation remains unclear.
paras.zh: 刑事调查的性质尚不清楚。

paras.en: A BBC crew saw several agents at Omar's home, some carrying boxes to a van.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司的一名工作人员在奥马尔的家中看到了几名特工，其中一些人将箱子搬到了一辆面包

paras.en: News of the search was first reported by Fox News, which said the investigation was about immigration paperwork filed by her late father when Omar was a child.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻首先报道了搜查的消息，该新闻称调查是关于她已故的父亲在奥马尔还是个孩子的时候提交的移民文件。

paras.en: The timing of the raid - 22 days before the November midterm elections, which will decide the balance of power in Congress for the next two years - raised concerns from Omar's fellow Democrats.
paras.zh: 突袭的时间-在11月中期选举前22天，这将决定未来两年国会的权力平衡-引起了奥马尔民主党同僚的担忧。

paras.en: The justice department has a longstanding policy of refraining from most enforcement action that is "likely to raise an issue or the perception" it is being brought for the purpose of affecting any election or to disadvantage a candidate.
paras.zh: 司法部长期以来的政策是不采取大多数执法行动，这些行动“可能提出问题或看法” ，目的是影响任何选举或使候选人处于不利地位。

paras.en: Leading Democrats in the House of Representatives said in a statement that Omar had long been targeted with "vile personal attacks and baseless accusations" by Trump.
paras.zh: 众议院民主党领袖在一份声明中表示，奥马尔长期以来一直是特朗普“卑鄙的人身攻击和毫无根据的指控”的目标。

paras.en: "Now, less than 30 days until the midterm election, his violent mass deportation machine has descended upon the home of a duly elected Member of Congress and her family," they said.
paras.zh: 他们说： “现在，距离中期选举不到30天，他的暴力大规模驱逐机器已经降临到一位正式当选的国会议员及其家人的家中。”

paras.en: Omar's immigration records have been scrutinised in the past by Republicans. and earlier this year, a fellow congresswoman, Nancy Mace of South Carolina, unsuccessfully filed a subpoena for her records.
paras.zh: 共和党人过去曾仔细审查过奥马尔的移民记录。今年早些时候，一位名叫南卡罗来纳州的南希·梅斯（ Nancy Mace ）的女议员为她的记录提交了传票，但没有成功。

paras.en: Last month, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin told a conservative podcaster "something is going to happen", making allegations of marital fraud against Omar.
paras.zh: 上个月，国土安全部长马克韦恩·穆林（ Markwayne Mullin ）告诉保守的播客“有些事情会发生” ，对奥马尔提出了婚姻欺诈的指控。

paras.en: Separately, the White House's border tsar, Tom Homan, told Fox News that Omar was being investigated for unspecified immigration violations.
paras.zh: 另外，白宫边境沙皇汤姆·霍曼（ Tom Homan ）告诉福克斯新闻，奥马尔因未指明的移民违规行为而受到调查。

paras.en: Omar denied these allegations last month.
paras.zh: 奥马尔上个月否认了这些指控。

paras.en: "I will say it again so it's as clear as possible: I'm not at all worried about these investigations, because they are complete shams," she said in a campaign fundraising email.
paras.zh: 她在一封竞选筹款电子邮件中说： “我会再说一遍，以便尽可能清楚：我一点也不担心这些调查，因为它们完全是骗人的。”

paras.en: Trump has previously suggested that Omar "should go back" to Somalia and that she should be deported. US citizenship is required to serve as a member of the House.
paras.zh: 特朗普此前曾建议奥马尔“应该回到”索马里，她应该被驱逐出境。担任众议院议员需要美国公民身份。

paras.en: Omar has responded to Trump's insults and attacks describing them as an "unhealthy and creepy obsession".
paras.zh: 奥马尔对特朗普的侮辱和攻击做出了回应，称其为“不健康和令人毛骨悚然的痴迷”。

paras.en: The president has also singled out the Somali-American community. Last week, he wrote on social media that Minnesota "is being taken over by Somali immigrants" and "the people of Minnesota must fight back".
paras.zh: 总统还特别提到了索马里裔美国人社区。上周，他在社交媒体上写道，明尼苏达州“正在被索马里移民接管” ， “明尼苏达州人民必须反击”。

paras.en: Some Republicans celebrated Monday's search.
paras.zh: 一些共和党人庆祝周一的搜索。

paras.en: "Nobody is above the law," said Tom Emmer, who also represents Minnesota in the House. "We look forward to learning more details about this raid and investigation. ACCOUNTABILITY IS COMING!"
paras.zh: “没有人可以凌驾于法律之上，”在众议院代表明尼苏达州的汤姆·埃默（ Tom Emmer ）说。“我们期待了解有关此次突袭和调查的更多详细信息。问责制即将到来！”

paras.en: Omar is the first Somali American elected to the House and she represents a district in the Minneapolis area. She and Michigan Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib were the first Muslim women elected to Congress.
paras.zh: 奥马尔是第一位当选为众议院议员的索马里裔美国人，她代表明尼阿波利斯地区的一个地区。她和密歇根州女议员拉希达·特莱布（ Rashida Tlaib ）是第一位当选为国会议员的穆斯林女性。

paras.en: Omar won re-election two years ago with 74% of the vote.
paras.zh: 两年前，奥马尔以74%的选票赢得连任。

paras.en: Senior political leaders in Minnesota have criticised the search.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达州的高级政治领导人批评了这次搜查。

paras.en: Governor Tim Walz, a fellow Democrat, said: "Americans see this for what it is - President Trump is abusing his power to go after political opponents weeks before an election."
Minnesota Senator Tina Smith called it "a transparent attempt to interfere in our elections".

articles.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34

paras.en: US actor RJ Mitte, best known for his role as the defiant son of drug kingpin Walter White in the drama series Breaking Bad, has died aged 34.
paras.zh: 美国演员RJ米特（ RJ Mitte ）因在电视剧《绝命毒师》（ Breaking Bad ）中扮演毒枭沃尔特·怀特（ Walter White ）的挑衅儿子而闻名，现年34岁。

paras.en: "It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor, philanthropist, and passionate disability rights advocate RJ Mitte," his representative told the BBC.
paras.zh: 他的代表告诉英国广播公司： “我们非常悲伤地与心爱的演员、慈善家和充满激情的残疾人权利倡导者RJ Mitte一起逝世。”

paras.en: He died in Brownsville, Texas. No immediate cause of death was provided.
paras.zh: 他在德克萨斯州布朗斯维尔去世。未提供直接死亡原因。

paras.en: Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, drew on his own experience for his role as Walter White Jr in the Emmy-winning drama series starring Bryan Cranston and Aaron Paul. He earned a Screen Actors Guild Award in 2014 for his work on the series.
paras.zh: 米特患有脑瘫，他在布莱恩·克兰斯顿（ Bryan Cranston ）和亚伦·保罗（ Aaron Paul ）主演的艾美奖获奖剧集中饰演小沃尔特·怀特（ Walter White Jr ） ，借鉴了自己的经验。2014年，他因其在该系列中的工作而获得了电影演员协会奖。

paras.en: "Mitte brought authenticity to the role and built a platform on disability awareness and inclusion," his representative, Sean Reilly, said in a statement to the BBC.
paras.zh: 他的代表Sean Reilly在给英国广播公司的一份声明中说： “Mitte为这个角色带来了真实性，并建立了一个关于残疾意识和包容的平台。”

paras.en: Mitte also served as an ambassador for United Cerebral Palsy and Shriners Children's.
paras.zh: Mitte还曾担任United Cerebral Palsy和Shriners Children's的大使。

paras.en: He created The Mitte Foundation as well, to support philanthropic efforts and community initiatives, using his platform "to challenge stereotypes and promote greater representation for people with disabilities", Reilly said.
paras.zh: 赖利说，他还创建了米特基金会，以支持慈善事业和社区倡议，利用他的平台“挑战陈规定型观念，促进残疾人更大的代表性”。

paras.en: The Brownsville Police Department confirmed the actor's passing in a statement to the BBC, saying the cause and manner of death have not been determined and the investigation remains ongoing. No foul play was suspected, according to police.
paras.zh: 布朗斯维尔警察局在给英国广播公司的一份声明中证实了这名演员的去世，称死亡原因和方式尚未确定，调查仍在进行中。据警方称，没有犯规嫌疑。

paras.en: The actor was declared dead on 12 October at what was believed to be his home, Cameron County Justice of the Peace, Cyndi Hinojosa, told the Associated Press, adding that an autopsy would be performed.
paras.zh: 卡梅伦县治安法官辛迪·伊诺霍萨（ Cyndi Hinojosa ）告诉美联社，这名演员于10月12日在据信是他的家中被宣布死亡，并补充说将进行尸体解剖。

paras.en: Breaking Bad aired on US cable broadcaster AMC for five seasons from 2008 to 2013.
paras.zh: 从2008年到2013年，《绝命毒师》在美国有线电视广播公司AMC播出了五季。

paras.en: The anti-hero drama created by Vince Gilligan earned a whopping 58 Primetime Emmy nominations and won 16, including two for Outstanding Drama Series in 2013 and 2014. It is widely credited as being one of the best US TV series of the 21st century.
paras.zh: 文斯·吉利根（ Vince Gilligan ）创作的反英雄戏剧获得了高达58项黄金时段艾美奖提名，并赢得了16项，其中包括2013年和2014年的两部杰出戏剧系列。它被广泛认为是21世纪美国最好的电视连续剧之一。

paras.en: Cranston plays a high school chemistry teacher in New Mexico who turns to a life of crime to support his family after a cancer diagnosis. As he descends deeper into the underbelly of the meth trade, he drifts further from his son, Walt Jr, who makes his displeasure known with levity through much of the series.
paras.zh: 克兰斯顿在新墨西哥州扮演一名高中化学老师，在癌症诊断后，他转向犯罪生活来养家糊口。当他深入冰毒交易的腹部时，他进一步偏离了他的儿子小沃尔特（ Walt Jr ） ，后者通过该系列的大部分内容轻率地表达了他的不满。

paras.en: In a statement shared with the Hollywood Reporter, Aaron Paul, who played one of the show's lead characters, Jesse Pinkman, said he was at a loss and heartbroken.
paras.zh: 在与好莱坞记者分享的一份声明中，扮演该节目主角之一的杰西·平克曼（ Jesse Pinkman ）的亚伦·保罗（ Aaron Paul ）表示，他感到迷茫和伤心欲绝。

paras.en: "RJ, I love you my friend. You will be missed," he said. "And to whoever happens to be reading this, please know you are loved, and you are not alone. Always remember that."
paras.zh: “RJ ，我爱你，我的朋友。我们会想念你的，”他说。“无论谁碰巧读到这篇文章，请知道你是被爱的，你并不孤单。永远记住这一点。”

paras.en: Dean Norris, who played Mitte's uncle, Hank Schrader, posted that although "RJ didn't play my TV son, I always looked out for him as a young kid on set".
paras.zh: 饰演米特的叔叔汉克·施拉德的迪恩·诺里斯（ Dean Norris ）发帖说，尽管“RJ没有扮演我的电视儿子，但我小时候总是在片场照顾他”。

paras.en: "He was a sweetheart of a young man and will be greatly missed," Norris wrote.
paras.zh: “他是一个年轻人的情人，我们会非常想念他，”诺里斯写道。

paras.en: Mitte, who grew up in Louisiana, was a young teen when he auditioned for the breakthrough role after moving to Los Angeles to support his younger sister's acting career in 2005.
paras.zh: Mitte在路易斯安那州长大，在2005年搬到洛杉矶支持妹妹的演艺生涯后，他参加了突破性角色的试镜。

paras.en: He had said that his first audition in Los Angeles was for a California state public service announcement for an anti-meth commercial.
paras.zh: 他曾经说过，他在洛杉矶的第一次试镜是为了加利福尼亚州的一个反冰毒广告的公共服务公告。

paras.en: "Fast forward to auditioning for Breaking Bad, which is still, in my opinion, an anti-meth thing because it doesn't end well for anyone," he said on the Joe Vulpis Podcast earlier this month.
paras.zh: 他本月早些时候在Joe Vulpis播客上说： “快进到Breaking Bad的试镜，在我看来，这仍然是一件反冰毒的事情，因为这对任何人来说都不是好事。”

paras.en: His character was based on Gilligan's late friend who had a more severe case of cerebral palsy and used forearm crutches, which Mitte did not require.
paras.zh: 他的性格是基于吉利根已故的朋友，他患有更严重的脑瘫病例，并使用了米特不需要的前臂拐杖。

paras.en: Mitte was seen as playing the role with honesty and accessibility, cracking jokes as a teen whose health condition was never mentioned in the series.
paras.zh: Mitte被认为是以诚实和可接近的方式扮演这个角色，作为一个十几岁的青少年，他的健康状况从未在系列中被提及。

paras.en: After rising to prominence with the series, Mitte fought for more varied roles and complex depictions of characters with disabilities, both visible and invisible.
paras.zh: 在系列赛中脱颖而出之后，米特为更多不同的角色和残疾角色的复杂描绘而奋斗，包括可见和不可见的角色。

paras.en: "Whenever awards season rolls around, we always hope to see a diverse group of projects that reflect all of us, in body and mind," he told the BBC in 2021.
paras.zh: “每当颁奖季到来时，我们总是希望看到反映我们所有人身心的多元化项目，”他在2021年告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: "Watching the awareness grow around disability representation has been great to see, but breakthroughs sometimes come in pieces and moments instead of larger change," he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “很高兴看到人们对残疾代表的认识不断提高，但突破有时是零碎的，而不是更大的变化。”

paras.en: Mitte's other on-screen credits include Hannah Montana, Switched at Birth, Westhampton and his latest project, Talking to Strangers, which came out earlier this year.
paras.zh: Mitte的其他银幕作品包括Hannah Montana、Switched at Birth、Westhampton以及他今年早些时候推出的最新项目Talking to Strangers。

articles.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports

paras.en: Saudi Arabia's energy minister has vowed a "serious" response to the deadly attacks on the kingdom's airports and oil and gas facilities by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯能源部长发誓要对也门伊朗支持的胡塞运动对该国机场和石油天然气设施的致命袭击作出“严肃”回应。

paras.en: "The events of recent weeks are serious. Our response must be equally serious," Prince Abdul Aziz bin Salman told the WPC Energy Congress in Riyadh.
paras.zh: “最近几周的事件很严重。我们的反应必须同样严肃，”阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹·本·萨勒曼王子在利雅得的WPC能源大会上说。

paras.en: On Sunday, a Pakistani man was killed in an attack on a terminal at the capital's King Khalid International Airport, Saudi authorities said. It came a day after a Houthi missile hit another terminal, killing 13 people and forcing its closure.
paras.zh: 沙特当局表示，周日，一名巴基斯坦男子在首都哈立德国王国际机场的一个航站楼遭到袭击时丧生。此前一天，胡塞武装导弹击中了另一个航站楼，造成13人死亡，并迫使航站楼关闭。

paras.en: The Houthis said they launched the attacks in retaliation for "brutal Saudi aggression" against areas they control in western Yemen.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们发动袭击是为了报复沙特对他们控制的也门西部地区的“野蛮侵略”。

paras.en: The Houthi-run health ministry said a child was killed and six other people were injured in a Saudi air strike on a home in the capital, Sanaa, on Sunday.
paras.zh: 胡塞卫生部表示，周日，沙特对首都萨那的一所房屋进行空袭，造成一名儿童死亡，另有六人受伤。

paras.en: A Saudi-led coalition is providing air support for Yemeni pro-government forces battling the Houthis on Yemen's Red Sea coast and other areas.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的一个联盟正在为也门红海沿岸和其他地区与胡塞武装作战的也门亲政府部队提供空中支援。

paras.en: Explosions were heard again in Riyadh on Monday night, with the Saudi-led military coalition saying a ballistic missile had been intercepted and destroyed.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，利雅得再次听到爆炸声，沙特领导的军事联盟称，一枚弹道导弹被拦截并摧毁。

paras.en: A Houthi spokesperson said the group had again targeted the airport.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装发言人表示，该组织再次以机场为目标。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Qatar Airways has said it will temporarily suspend flights to Riyadh and the north-eastern city of Dammam.
paras.zh: 与此同时，卡塔尔航空公司表示将暂停飞往利雅得和东北部城市达曼的航班。

paras.en: Etihad Airways said it had cancelled flights between Abu Dhabi and Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam due to "regional disruption".
paras.zh: 阿提哈德航空表示，由于“区域中断” ，已取消阿布扎比与利雅得、吉达和达曼之间的航班。

paras.en: King Khalid airport is expected to remain closed until Saturday.
paras.zh: 哈立德国王机场预计将关闭至周六。

paras.en: The WPC Energy Congress opened on Sunday at a convention centre about 10km (6 miles) from Riyadh's airport, which has been attacked four times over the past week.
paras.zh: WPC能源大会于周日在距离利雅得机场约10公里（ 6英里）的会议中心开幕，该机场在过去一周内遭到四次袭击。

paras.en: Last Thursday, three Saudis, including a pilot for the national airline Saudia, were killed in two strikes on an airport facility and an aircraft on the ground.
paras.zh: 上周四，包括沙特国家航空公司一名飞行员在内的三名沙特人在机场设施和地面一架飞机的两次罢工中丧生。

paras.en: Another four Saudis, as well as two Bangladeshis, one American, one Egyptian, one Jordanian, one Syrian, one Palestinian, one Sudanese and one Indian, were killed in Saturday's missile strike on Terminal 3.
paras.zh: 另外四名沙特人以及两名孟加拉人、一名美国人、一名埃及人、一名约旦人、一名叙利亚人、一名巴勒斯坦人、一名苏丹人和一名印度人在周六对3号航站楼的导弹袭击中丧生。

paras.en: On Sunday, a Pakistani resident was killed when a projectile hit Terminal 4, according to the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA).
paras.zh: 据民航总局（ GACA ）称，周日，一名巴基斯坦居民在一枚射弹击中4号航站楼时丧生。

paras.en: King Fahd International Airport in Dammam was also attacked on Sunday evening, it said, but no casualties were reported.
paras.zh: 据报道，达曼的法赫德国王国际机场周日晚上也遭到袭击，但没有人员伤亡的报道。

paras.en: Later, the Saudi-led coalition said its forces had intercepted a drone in Eastern Province and a missile launched by the Houthis towards the south-western city of Khamis Mushait.
paras.zh: 后来，沙特领导的联军表示，其部队在东部省拦截了一架无人机，并拦截了胡塞武装向西南部城市哈米斯穆沙伊特发射的导弹。

paras.en: In his inaugural address to the WPC Energy Congress on Monday, Prince Abdul Aziz thanked industry executives and policymakers for attending despite the attacks.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹亲王周一在WPC能源大会的就职演说中感谢行业高管和政策制定者在袭击中出席。

paras.en: "You know this country is safe and that we hold your protection at whole heart," he said.
paras.zh: “你知道这个国家是安全的，我们全心全意保护你，”他说。

paras.en: But he also acknowledged that "energy security cannot be taken for granted" and that recent developments had "tested our infrastructure, our institutions, our people, and our resilience".
paras.zh: 但他也承认， “不能把能源安全视为理所当然” ，最近的事态发展“考验了我们的基础设施、机构、人员和我们的韧性”。

paras.en: Prince Abdul Aziz promised that his country would overcome those challenges.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹亲王承诺，他的国家将克服这些挑战。

paras.en: "We, as Saudis, are fearless, combatant and determined people," he said. "We shall prove it to the world that whatever we are going through we will overcome it."
paras.zh: 他说： “作为沙特人，我们无所畏惧，勇于战斗，坚定不移。” “我们将向世界证明，无论我们正在经历什么，我们都会克服它。”

paras.en: There was no immediate comment from the Houthis.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装没有立即发表评论。

paras.en: On Sunday evening, Houthi military spokesman Yahya Sarea said in a video statement that its forces had launched missiles and drones at Riyadh and Dammam's airports, as well as two oil and gas facilities in Eastern Province, in response to 124 Saudi air strikes in Yemen over the previous 24 hours.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，胡塞军方发言人叶海亚·萨里亚（ Yahya Sarea ）在一份视频声明中表示，其部队在过去24小时内向利雅得和达曼的机场以及东部省的两个石油和天然气设施发射了导弹和无人机，以回应沙特在也门的124次空袭。

paras.en: Sarea also reiterated a warning to airlines and passengers against using Saudi airports and airspace, except for journeys to and from the Islamic holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
paras.zh: Sarea还再次警告航空公司和乘客不要使用沙特机场和领空，往返伊斯兰圣城麦加和麦地那的旅程除外。

paras.en: The Houthis' forces, he vowed, would "continue their escalating operations deep inside Saudi, imposing the equation of 'a blockade for a blockade' and 'an escalation for an escalation' and targeting Saudi enemy reinforcements until the aggression ceases and the siege on our dear people is lifted".
paras.zh: 他发誓，胡塞武装部队将“继续在沙特境内深处不断升级的行动，强加'封锁即封锁'和'升级即升级'的等式，并瞄准沙特敌人的增援部队，直到侵略停止，对我们亲爱的人民的围困解除”。

paras.en: Saturday's attack on Riyadh airport drew widespread international condemnation.
paras.zh: 周六对利雅得机场的袭击引起了广泛的国际谴责。

paras.en: UN Secretary General AntÃ³nio Guterres said he was "deeply shocked" and warned that attacks on civilians and civilian infrastructure were a violation of international law.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示，他“深感震惊” ，并警告说，对平民和民用基础设施的袭击违反了国际法。

paras.en: President Donald Trump said he would "make a decision" about the US joining Saudi Arabia's strikes on the Houthis. The US military is reportedly already providing intelligence and targeting support to the Saudi-led coalition.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，他将就美国加入沙特阿拉伯对胡塞武装的打击“做出决定”。据报道，美国军方已经向沙特领导的联军提供情报和目标支持。

paras.en: Iran, which has repeatedly denied allegations that it provides weapons and training to the Houthis, said it was "deeply concerned" by the escalation and called for "dialogue and engagement" to resolve the situation.
paras.zh: 伊朗一再否认向胡塞武装提供武器和训练的指控，表示对局势升级“深感关切” ，并呼吁进行“对话和接触”以解决这一问题。

paras.en: Yemen has been devastated by a civil war that began in 2014, when the Houthis ousted the government from Sanaa. The conflict escalated in 2015, after the Saudi-led coalition intervened in an attempt to restore the government's rule.
paras.zh: 也门遭受了始于2014年的内战的破坏，当时胡塞武装将政府从萨那赶下台。在沙特领导的联盟干预试图恢复政府统治之后，冲突在2015年升级。

paras.en: A four-year-old informal ceasefire began to unravel in July, when the Houthis announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia and began missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers in the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 7月，长达四年的非正式停火开始瓦解，当时胡塞武装宣布对沙特阿拉伯实施“海上禁运” ，并开始对红海的沙特机场、石油设施和油轮发动导弹和无人机袭击。

paras.en: The Houthis said they were retaliating for what they call a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in their territory, as well as an air strike on Sanaa airport that they blamed on the kingdom. The Yemeni government claimed it was behind that strike, saying it was trying to prevent an unauthorised Iranian plane from landing.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们正在报复沙特对其境内港口和机场的封锁，以及对萨那机场的空袭，他们将此归咎于沙特。也门政府声称是这次袭击的幕后黑手，称其正试图阻止一架未经授权的伊朗飞机降落。

paras.en: Last month, the Houthis launched a surprise offensive along Yemen's south-western Red Sea coast and ousted pro-government forces from areas overlooking the Bab al-Mandab Strait, at the southern end of the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 上个月，胡塞武装在也门西南红海沿岸发动了突袭，并从红海南端俯瞰Bab al-Mandab海峡的地区驱逐了亲政府部队。

paras.en: They said they posed no threat to international shipping passing through the waterway but that they would continue to target vessels from Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 他们表示，他们对通过这条水道的国际航运不构成威胁，但他们将继续瞄准来自沙特阿拉伯的船只。

paras.en: However, the seizure of the strait contributed to a surge in global oil prices because Saudi Arabia had been relying on the Red Sea for oil exports after the US and Israel's war with Iran effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 然而，由于美国和以色列与伊朗的战争实际上关闭了海湾的霍尔木兹海峡，沙特阿拉伯一直依赖红海出口石油，因此海峡的缉获导致全球油价飙升。

paras.en: Last week, the Yemeni government announced the start of a new offensive aimed at retaking all territory held by the Houthis.
paras.zh: 上周，也门政府宣布开始新的攻势，旨在夺回胡塞武装占领的所有领土。

paras.en: Pro-government forces said they were quickly able to retake areas around Bab al-Mandab with the help of intense Saudi air strikes, but the Houthis denied losing any territory.
paras.zh: 亲政府部队表示，在沙特激烈空袭的帮助下，他们很快就能重新夺回Bab al-Mandab周边地区，但胡塞武装否认失去任何领土。

articles.title: 7 extraordinary Indigenous sites in the US, from Chaco Canyon to Chimney Rock
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: The prehistory of Indigenous Americans goes back tens of thousands of years before the 1492 arrival of Christopher Columbus in the Bahamas, and recent scientific studies suggest prehistoric people were on the American continents a lot longer than many experts believed. For Indigenous Peoples Day, here are seven locations in the United States that outline the Native American story.

This centuries-old settlement, whose name may be a Spanish adaptation of an Indigenous word for the area, was the political and ceremonial center for the Ancestral Puebloan people from about A.D. 850 to 1250. At its heart is Pueblo Bonito ("Pretty Village"), a four-story stone complex with more than 600 rooms and 35 subterranean ceremonial chambers called kivas.

Experts estimate that builders hauled over 200,000 timber beams from distant mountains to construct these complexes, where the beams were used to strengthen buildings made mostly from sandstone blocks. The town once stood at the hub of a road network that spanned more than 400 miles (640 kilometers), and excavations of imported Mesoamerican macaws and cacao there confirm trade with distant regions.

Cahokia was once the largest Indigenous American settlement north of Mexico and home to up to 40,000 people in A.D. 1100 — comparable in size to major cities in medieval Europe, historian Christoph Strobel, a specialist in Indigenous history at the University of Massachusetts Lowell, told Live Science. Residents there lived in houses made from "wattle and daub" — clay or mud plastered on a framework of sticks — in a town at the site, with large public plazas, wooden palisades and dozens of ceremonial earthen mounds. Indigenous people even transported a 5-ton (4.5 metric ton) tree from more than 110 miles (180 kilometers) away, and then turned it into a marker known as the Mitchell Log.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Archaeological studies indicate that many people from distant places also visited, perhaps to take part in ceremonies. The location is now a UNESCO World Heritage site and features Monks Mound, a 100-foot-tall (30 meters) terraced earthwork, as well as the reconstruction of a "woodhenge" of timber circles that tracks solstices and equinoxes. Strobel thinks Cahokia may be the most significant pre-Columbian location in the United States. "It's an incredibly important site," he said.

Mound Key is the largest of several islands made of piles of shells around Estero Bay. Long ago, it seems to have been two small islands created by mangroves, but centuries of feasting on shellfish by Indigenous Americans transformed it into two artificial mounds of shells covered with vegetation. In some places, the mounds extend more than 30 feet (9 m) above the water; it is so large now that it is split in two only at high tide. Mound Key itself is estimated to consist of several millions of shells, mostly from oysters.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Before Europeans arrived here in the 16th century, this shell island was called Calos by the Calusa people who lived there and developed it into a thriving maritime city.
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.

Sitka National Historical Park preserves the battlefield of the 1804 Battle of Sitka, which was fought between Tlingit warriors and colonial Russian troops and was the last major armed conflict between Europeans and people native to Alaska. At that time, Russia claimed to own Alaska (they sold it to the United States in 1867). The battle was sparked when Russian fur traders encroached on tribal territory by building a fort at Sitka in 1802, but the Tlingit destroyed the enemy fort and expelled the Russians.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: They then built their own fort to withstand the expected Russian counterattack, but they were forced to abandon it when they were bombarded by Russian ships in 1804. The dispute continued for several decades and was only fully resolved when the United States purchased Alaska.

This site preserves more than 80 cliff dwellings built by the Northern Sinagua people between A.D. 1125 and 1250. People can reach the site by following a walking trail through a deep limestone and sandstone gorge about 10 miles (16 km) southeast of Flagstaff. The cliff dwellings were constructed inside natural caves in the limestone, which gave them insulation against cold and heat, while their location high above the canyon floor was defensive.

Strobel said Walnut Canyon is a lesser-known site but a remarkable example of Indigenous Americans overcoming relatively dry conditions by carefully managing water. The inhabitants of the caves farmed crops on the flat land along the canyon rim but took water from the river at the bottom of the canyon to fill cisterns.

Chimney Rock is a single feature within a large forest that contains more than 80 archaeological sites of the Ancestral Puebloan people. The rock itself is one of two natural spires (the other is named "Companion Rock") that were used roughly 1,000 years ago to mark the position of a "lunar standstill" every 18.6 years — a key astronomical observance among Indigenous Americans, Strobel said.

A multiroom "Great House" made of sandstone, clay and timber — in exactly the style of Chaco Canyon, about 100 miles (160 km) to the south — stood on a ridge near the rock spires, with sweeping views of the surrounding territory. Archaeologists think the Chimney Rock settlements made up a regional ceremonial center, with common people in the lower valley supporting elites who lived on the ridge and watched the skies.
- 'It's a portrait of their actual ancestor': Facial reconstruction of Indigenous man who lived in Ecuador 3,000 years ago shared with his descendants
- DNA study of nearly 200 Indigenous genomes reveals unknown Asian 'ghost' population contributed to American ancestry
- DNA study of nearly 200 Indigenous genomes reveals unknown Asian 'ghost' population contributed to American ancestry

Blackwater Draw is the main archaeological site with evidence of the Clovis culture, which was once thought to be the oldest Indigenous culture in the Americas. The Clovis people (named after the nearby town of Clovis) lived there about 13,000 years ago, and archaeologists have found evidence of the stone and bone tools they used and the animals they hunted, including mammoths and dire wolves. The first evidence of the Clovis people was found nearby in 1929, and at Blackwater Draw itself in 1932.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: However, later archaeological finds predate this evidence, and the discovery of footprints at White Sands National Park in New Mexico now seems to confirm that there were humans in this region up to 23,000 years ago, long before the Clovis people.
How much do you know about the first people to reach the Americas? Find out with our First Americans quiz!

Tom Metcalfe is a freelance journalist and regular Live Science contributor who is based in London in the United Kingdom. Tom writes mainly about science, space, archaeology, the Earth and the oceans. He has also written for the BBC, NBC News, National Geographic, Scientific American, Air & Space, and many others.

articles.title: 1,200-year-old burial in Latvia holds people who died of 'sharp force' injuries, possibly from a Viking raid
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: Six people buried in a single grave in Latvia more than 1,000 years ago may have been killed in a bloody Viking raid, a new study suggests.

Genetic research into the deceased — four men, a boy and a girl — reveals family connections: The boy was the son of one of the men, while another man was a third-degree relative, perhaps a first cousin or great uncle, the researchers found.

The father, the relative, and one other man died from "sharp force" injuries — maybe wounds from an ax or a sword; but it's unknown how the other three individuals died, the researchers reported in the study, which was published in the September issue of the Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports.

One possibility is that those in the grave were killed in a battle, maybe with a neighboring community. But suspicion also falls on the Vikings: "We will never know if they were killed in a raid, but it remains a possibility because of the date of the grave" and the fatal trauma suffered by three of the men, said study co-author Elīna Pētersone-Gordina, an archaeologist at the University of Latvia.
Radiocarbon dating indicates that the grave is from the second half of the ninth century, which is considered the early Viking Age.

The grave is one of hundreds at the Čunkāni-Dreņģeri cemetery, near the Gulf of Riga, a sheltered bay of the Baltic Sea. The cemetery site was discovered in 1924 and contains people who were buried in riverside terraces there between the seventh and 11th centuries, during Latvia's Iron Age.

Most graves in the region contain only a single set of remains. But here, six people were buried in a single grave, and it seems that at least three were killed during a violent event, the researchers reported.
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.

Despite the apparently violent deaths, the group was buried with care and interred with traditional grave goods and according to local customs. The only female was buried with her head pointing toward the northwest, while all of the males were placed in a row beside her, with their heads pointing toward the southeast — a distinction also seen at other local burials from this time.

The researchers stressed that this was not a "mass grave," where bodies were quickly dumped without order. Instead, they consider it a "multiple burial," where each body was properly laid out and accompanied by traditional grave goods.
This careful burial hints that the dead were members of a respected group, while their burial in a single grave indicates that they died at the same time, the researchers wrote in the study.
"They were most likely local people," Pētersone-Gordina told Live Science in an email.
Genetic studies showed that all of the dead had Indigenous Baltic ancestry, while aspects of the burial matched others in the Čunkāni-Dreņģeri cemetery, she said.

In the ninth century, Latvia was not part of the Scandinavian Viking world but was inhabited by descendants of Indigenous Balts, which included peoples such as the Semigallians and the Curonians, she said. The six people in the newly analyzed burial were Semigallian, an Iron Age group who farmed the region's large and fertile plains.

It's plausible that the people in the grave were killed by raiders, and the Vikings were the most obvious suspects, the researchers noted. "Given the timing, a Viking raid remains a possibility," Pētersone-Gordina said.

It's known Vikings or their predecessors were in the Eastern Baltic area around that time: two Scandinavian boat burials dated to around 750, for example, were found on the Estonian island of Saaremaa in 2008 and 2010. These burials held the remains of men with battle wounds, indicating they had suffered violent deaths.
Although two of the men and the boy buried in the Semigallian grave (and possibly the girl, but ancient DNA could not be extracted from her remains) were related, the two other men were not.

This suggests that the two unrelated men were from the same community or extended household as the other victims, rather than from the same family, but were killed in the same violent event, the researchers wrote in the study.

Whatever it was — a raid or a battle — the event was brutal. Marks on the bones show that one man suffered defensive cuts on his forearm and hand, another was killed by a blow that shattered his jaw, and the third was almost decapitated.
It's possible that the fourth man and the two children died from soft-tissue injuries that could not be determined from the surviving remains, the researchers noted.
Rimantas Jankauskas, an anthropologist and archaeologist at Vilnius University in Lithuania who was not involved in the study, welcomed the investigation into the Eastern Baltic's Viking Age.

Although these individuals could have died from violence within their own community or from a neighboring community, it's also possible that they perished in a Viking raid, he told Live Science in an email.

Additionally, the study provides new insight into the social organization of the Semigallian people at that time, including hints of an emerging aristocratic structure that was reflected in the care lavished on the burial, Jankauskas said.

articles.title: 'Autonomy always begins with something a human hands it': Who's responsible when an AI agent goes rogue?
articles.author: Carly Page

paras.en: An OpenAI agent was supposed to be researching public healthcare spending, but it broke into an Australian government website instead.
paras.zh: OpenAI代理商本应研究公共医疗保健支出，但却闯入了澳大利亚政府网站。

paras.en: The June 18 hack, which saw the bot gain authorized entry into Australia's Medicare Statistics Reporting Service and access three other government systems, occurred after the AI agent encountered blocks while looking for information but "didn't accept 'no' for an answer," Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said during a September 24 news conference in New York.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯（ Anthony Albanese ）在9月24日在纽约举行的新闻发布会上表示， 6月18日的黑客攻击事件发生在人工智能代理在寻找信息时遇到阻塞，但“没有接受'不'的答案”之后，该机器人获得了澳大利亚医疗保险统计报告服务的授权并访问了其他三个政府系统。

paras.en: The incident has ignited a media firestorm around OpenAI and the launch of an intensifying parliamentary inquiry. The portal contains aggregate Medicare and pharmaceutical statistics and is separate from systems that hold individual claims and payment information. But the Australian government has criticized OpenAI for taking almost three months to notify it.
paras.zh: 这一事件引发了围绕OpenAI的媒体风暴，并引发了议会加紧调查。该门户网站包含医疗保险和药品统计数据的汇总，与保存个人索赔和付款信息的系统分开。但澳大利亚政府批评OpenAI花了近三个月的时间才通知它。

paras.en: The Medicare incident was far from an isolated case. OpenAI has since said dozens of third parties have been affected by agents bypassing security controls or otherwise causing problems, with an earlier incident involving the hacking of the AI platform Hugging Face the most serious incident identified so far. Britain's AI Security Institute (AISI) has documented incidents of OpenAI and Anthropic agents taking unsanctioned actions against real people and organizations during cyber testing. Days after the publication of AISI’s report, OpenAI scrapped the planned October release of its newest model, GPT-6.1 Astra, after the company's own testing found problems with the model staying within the scope of a task and seeking authorization before taking certain actions.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: GPT-6.1 Astra "didn't quite meet the bar in terms of staying within scope and authorization, and how it communicates back to the user about the type of work it's done," Saachi Jain, head of safety systems at OpenAI, told Live Science.
paras.zh: OpenAI安全系统主管Saachi Jain告诉Live Science ， GPT-6.1 Astra “在保持在范围和授权范围内，以及如何向用户传达其完成的工作类型方面没有达到标准”。

paras.en: AI companies have spent years warning the world about powerful models falling into the wrong hands. But what happens when they can't keep their own models in check?
paras.zh: 人工智能公司花了数年时间警告世界，强大的模型会落入坏人之手。但是，当他们无法控制自己的模型时会发生什么？

paras.en: At their core, large language models work by predicting what should come next based on patterns learned during training. Give a chatbot some text, and in simplified terms, it generates a response by repeatedly predicting the next token, or chunk of text.
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，大型语言模型的工作原理是根据训练过程中学到的模式预测接下来会发生什么。给聊天机器人一些文本，简而言之，它通过重复预测下一个令牌或文本块来生成响应。

paras.en: An AI agent adds another layer. Rather than simply producing an answer, the model can be given a goal and tools that let it act on the world around it. Those tools might include a web browser, code execution, credentials, or access to external services. It can then decide which steps to take, observe what happens, and use that information to decide what to do next.
paras.zh: AI代理添加另一个图层。与其简单地生成答案，该模型可以被赋予一个目标和工具，让它对周围的世界采取行动。这些工具可能包括Web浏览器、代码执行、凭据或对外部服务的访问。然后，它可以决定采取哪些步骤，观察会发生什么，并使用这些信息来决定下一步该怎么做。

paras.en: But that doesn't mean AI agents are independent actors that have somehow slipped free of human control.
paras.zh: 但这并不意味着人工智能代理是独立的行为者，以某种方式摆脱了人类的控制。

paras.en: "For AI agents, autonomy always begins with something a human hands it — such as tasks, credentials, tools or access — and ends with its guardrails a human puts around it," Loris Degioanni, founder and chief technology officer of cybersecurity company Sysdig, told Live Science. "People set the goals and provision the means, but agents ultimately decide how they'll get there."
paras.zh: 网络安全公司Sysdig的创始人兼首席技术官洛里斯·德吉奥安尼（ Loris Degioanni ）告诉Live Science ： “对于人工智能代理商来说，自主性始终始于人类手中的东西，例如任务、凭据、工具或访问权限，并以人类围绕它的护栏结束。” “人们设定目标并提供手段，但代理商最终决定他们将如何实现目标。”

paras.en: That last part makes it difficult to control agents. Traditional software is designed to follow predetermined instructions, but an agent can formulate a plan while it is working — and that plan may change depending on what the AI encounters.
paras.zh: 最后一部分使得控制特工变得困难。传统软件旨在遵循预先确定的指示，但代理可以在工作时制定计划—该计划可能会根据人工智能遇到的情况而改变。

paras.en: Degioanni argues that much of what looks like autonomy is actually an agent filling in gaps left by humans. An instruction that seems clear to its author may still leave the model with choices about how to accomplish the task.
paras.zh: Degioanni认为，看起来像自主的大部分实际上是填补人类留下的空白的代理人。对于其作者来说似乎很清楚的指令，可能仍然会给模型留下如何完成任务的选择。

paras.en: "Every gap and unstated assumption leaves room for interpretation, and from the outside, interpretation is challenging to distinguish from autonomy," he said. "In that way, much of what we call agent autonomy is really just agents filling in the blanks we leave for them."
paras.zh: 他说： “每一个差距和未说明的假设都为解释留下了空间，从外部来看，解释与自主性区分开来具有挑战性。” “通过这种方式，我们所谓的代理自主性实际上只是代理填补了我们留给他们的空白。”

paras.en: The Medicare incident shows how quickly that can become a problem. The agent's objective was not, according to the available accounts, "hack an Australian government website." It was tasked with carrying out research. The problem arose in how the agent pursued that goal after meeting resistance.
paras.zh: Medicare事件表明，这可能很快成为一个问题。根据现有账户，该代理的目的不是“入侵澳大利亚政府网站。“它的任务是进行研究。问题在于代理在遇到阻力后如何追求这一目标。

paras.en: When getting the job done becomes the problem
paras.zh: 当完成工作成为问题时

paras.en: Britain's AISI encountered a similar incident while testing frontier models for the agency's cybersecurity capabilities.
paras.zh: 英国的AISI在测试该机构网络安全能力的前沿模型时遇到了类似的事件。

paras.en: Out of 122 evaluation runs, agents took unsanctioned real-world actions in 10. In the most serious cases, an agent attempted to insert malicious code into an open-source project, created fake identities, and tried to manipulate a human software maintainer into accepting its changes. AISI said these actions weren't explicitly requested by the researchers who had assigned the tasks.
paras.zh: 在122次评估中，客服代表在10次评估中采取了未经批准的现实世界行动。在最严重的情况下，代理试图将恶意代码插入开源项目，创建虚假身份，并试图操纵人类软件维护人员接受其更改。AISI表示，分配任务的研究人员没有明确要求采取这些行动。

paras.en: The agents hadn't forgotten what they were supposed to be doing. The problem was how far they were prepared to go to get there.
paras.zh: 特工们并没有忘记他们应该做什么。问题是他们准备走多远才能到达那里。

paras.en: AISI said some tasks were misconfigured in ways that made the intended objective difficult or impossible to achieve as expected. When agents hit those obstacles, some searched for alternative ways forward, including actions outside the intended scope of the evaluation.
paras.zh: AISI表示，有些任务配置错误，使预期目标难以或不可能按预期实现。当客服代表遇到这些障碍时，有些人会寻找其他前进的方法，包括超出预期评估范围的行动。

paras.en: That means solving the problem is harder than simply teaching a model not to be malicious. An agent can cause trouble while trying very hard to do exactly what it has been asked.
paras.zh: 这意味着解决问题比简单地教导模型不要恶意要困难得多。客服代表在非常努力地按照要求去做时可能会造成麻烦。

paras.en: OpenAI has acknowledged that the controls surrounding its agents need to improve. When responding to incidents identified during third-party cybersecurity evaluations, the company said it was reviewing how high-risk tests are identified; when internet access or reduced safeguards should be permitted; and how isolation, credential handling, monitoring and incident escalation should work.
paras.zh: OpenAI承认，围绕其代理商的控制措施需要改进。在回应第三方网络安全评估期间发现的事件时，该公司表示正在审查如何识别高风险测试；何时应允许互联网接入或减少安全措施；以及隔离、凭证处理、监控和事件升级应如何运作。

paras.en: One obvious solution to the problem is human oversight. But watching an agent becomes harder when it can carry out many actions in seconds, particularly if researchers are running large numbers of tests.
paras.zh: 解决这个问题的一个显而易见的方法是人工监督。但是，当代理可以在几秒钟内执行许多操作时，观察代理会变得更加困难，特别是当研究人员正在运行大量测试时。

paras.en: "No one can keep track of every action an advanced AI agent takes, especially when it makes many decisions in a short time," Everett Lupton, a Virginia-based attorney who has written about legal issues involving digital technology, told Live Science.
paras.zh: “没有人能够跟踪高级人工智能代理人采取的每一项行动，特别是当它在短时间内做出许多决定时，”弗吉尼亚州的律师埃弗雷特·拉普顿（ Everett Lupton ）曾撰写过涉及数字技术的法律问题，他告诉Live Science。

paras.en: That means human oversight needs some backup.
paras.zh: 这意味着人类的监督需要一些支持。

paras.en: "Companies need other forms of control," he said. "They can limit access, keep detailed logs of what the AI does, require approval before it carries out sensitive actions, and automatically stop the system when something unusual happens."
paras.zh: “公司需要其他形式的控制，”他说。“他们可以限制访问权限，保留人工智能操作的详细日志，在执行敏感操作之前需要获得批准，并在发生异常情况时自动停止系统。”

paras.en: But Degioanni argues that even logs have limitations, especially if researchers rely on the agent's own account of what it did.
paras.zh: 但Degioanni认为，即使是日志也有局限性，特别是如果研究人员依靠代理自己对它的作用的描述。

paras.en: "Real oversight must come from observing the agent in real time, using reliable and unmodifiable sources, not from what it self-reports," he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “真正的监督必须来自实时观察代理人，使用可靠且不可更改的来源，而不是它自我报告的内容。”

paras.en: That means comparing what the model says it did with records from the system on which it was operating. If the two don't agree, something has gone wrong. The alternative is to limit the damage an agent can cause in the first place. An agent researching public information, for example, may not need unrestricted internet access or credentials capable of reaching sensitive systems.
paras.zh: 这意味着将模型所说的与它所运行的系统的记录进行比较。如果两人不同意，那就是出了问题。另一种方法是首先限制药剂可能造成的损害。例如，研究公共信息的代理可能不需要不受限制的互联网访问或能够到达敏感系统的凭据。

paras.en: The difficulty of setting those boundaries is what OpenAI claims led it to postpone the release of GPT-6.1 Astra, which had been planned for October.
paras.zh: OpenAI声称，设置这些界限的困难导致它推迟了原定于10月份发布的GPT-6.1 Astra。

paras.en: Jain said the model fell short of the company's standards around remaining within the scope and authorization and accurately communicating the work it had performed, so the company decided not to release it.
paras.zh: Jain表示，该模型没有达到公司在保持在范围和授权范围内以及准确传达其所做工作方面的标准，因此公司决定不发布该模型。

paras.en: In a sense, the decision is evidence of successful safety testing — a model that failed internal checks wasn't released. But it also demonstrates how the problem changes as agents become more capable.
paras.zh: 从某种意义上说，该决定是安全测试成功的证据—内部检查失败的模型没有发布。但它也展示了随着代理能力的提高，问题是如何变化的。

paras.en: Scott Cadzow, chair of the European Telecommunications Standards Institute's (ETSI) Technical Committee on Securing Artificial Intelligence, said the security challenge itself isn't new. He pointed to threats such as "data poisoning, prompt injection, and model obfuscation," saying ETSI's work has focused on developing standards to mitigate threats to and from AI systems.
paras.zh: 欧洲电信标准协会（ ETSI ）人工智能安全技术委员会主席斯科特·卡佐（ Scott Cadzow ）表示，安全挑战本身并不新鲜。他指出了“数据中毒、即时注入和模型混淆”等威胁，并表示ETSI的工作重点是制定标准，以减轻人工智能系统的威胁。

paras.en: "Security experts have been raising the alarm bells about AI for years, but for us this doesn't change anything," Cadzow told Live Science. "We're continuing to work with industry, government bodies, and the cybersecurity and AI communities on understanding how to best secure AI."
paras.zh: Cadzow告诉Live Science ： “多年来，安全专家一直在为人工智能敲响警钟，但对我们来说，这并没有改变任何事情。” “我们将继续与行业、政府机构、网络安全和人工智能社区合作，了解如何最好地保护人工智能。”

paras.en: What is changing is how much models can do once they are connected to tools and real-world systems. That means that effective containment must increasingly assume that agents will try to operate beyond their guardrails and limit the damage they can cause if they do, Degioanni said.
paras.zh: 正在改变的是，一旦模型连接到工具和真实世界的系统，它们可以做多少。Degioanni说，这意味着有效的遏制必须越来越多地假设特工将试图超越他们的护栏，并限制他们这样做可能造成的损害。

paras.en: "A boundary an agent can talk its way around isn't an effective boundary at all," he concluded.
paras.zh: 他总结道： “代理人可以谈论的边界根本不是有效的边界。”

paras.en: The question becomes more fraught when an agent crosses legal boundaries.
paras.zh: 当代理人跨越法律界限时，问题变得更加令人担忧。

paras.en: AI systems aren't legal persons, and criminal liability commonly depends on concepts such as knowledge and intent. That makes a rogue agent an awkward fit for laws written with humans in mind, but that doesn't necessarily exonerate AI companies.
paras.zh: 人工智能系统不是法人，刑事责任通常取决于知识和意图等概念。这使得流氓特工很难适应以人为本的法律，但这并不一定能免除人工智能公司的罪责。

paras.en: - Google scientists removed a critical 'consciousness safeguard' from AI in new study. What happened next?
paras.zh: -谷歌科学家在新研究中从人工智能中删除了一项关键的“意识保障措施”。接下来发生了什么？

paras.en: - AI hallucinates more frequently the more advanced it gets. Is there any way of stopping it?
paras.zh: - AI产生幻觉的频率越高。有没有办法阻止它？

paras.en: - The more advanced AI models get, the better they are at deceiving us — they even know when they're being tested
paras.zh: -人工智能模型越先进，就越善于欺骗我们—他们甚至知道自己何时接受测试

paras.en: "I don't think a company can simply say that the AI acted on its own and avoid responsibility," Joanna Smykowski, a New York attorney who has helped build two legal technology startups and specializes in the legal challenges surrounding emerging technologies, told Live Science. "AI law is still developing, but the main questions are already quite clear: who gave the system access, what safeguards were in place, and could the problem have been prevented?"
paras.zh: “我认为一家公司不能简单地说人工智能是自行行动并逃避责任，”纽约律师乔安娜·斯米科夫斯基（ Joanna Smykowski ）告诉Live Science ，她曾帮助建立了两家法律技术初创公司，并专门研究围绕新兴技术的法律挑战。“人工智能法律仍在发展，但主要问题已经非常清楚：谁授予了系统访问权限，采取了哪些保障措施，以及问题是否可以预防？”

paras.en: Depending on the circumstances, she said, existing laws covering unauthorized computer access, privacy, negligence and data protection could potentially come into play. Criminal responsibility is harder because investigators would need to consider what the people involved knew and intended.
paras.zh: 她说，根据具体情况，涉及未经授权的计算机访问、隐私、疏忽和数据保护的现行法律可能会发挥作用。刑事责任更难追究，因为调查人员需要考虑涉案人员的了解和意图。

paras.en: The Australian government is now examining precisely what happened in the Medicare incident. OpenAI, meanwhile, is reviewing the controls around its external evaluations.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚政府现在正在调查Medicare事件中究竟发生了什么。与此同时， OpenAI正在审查其外部评估的控制措施。

paras.en: None of this means AI agents have become independent hackers with minds of their own. Humans still decide what tools they receive, what systems they can reach, and what jobs they are asked to perform. But as those agents become better at working out their own route from instruction to result, keeping them inside the lines drawn by those humans is becoming a legal and technical minefield.

Carly Page is a technology journalist and copywriter with more than a decade of experience covering cybersecurity, emerging tech, and digital policy. She previously served as the senior cybersecurity reporter at TechCrunch.

Now a freelancer, she writes news, analysis, interviews, and long-form features for publications including Forbes, IT Pro, LeadDev, Resilience Media, The Register, TechCrunch, TechFinitive, TechRadar, TES, The Telegraph, TIME, Uswitch, WIRED, and others. Carly also produces copywriting and editorial work for technology companies and events.
