articles.title: A Century Ago, an Extinct Crocodilian's Skull Was Found in the Rocks That Built the Sphinx. Turns Out, It Belonged to a New Species

paras.en: Around 4,500 years ago, ancient Egyptians carved the Great Sphinx of Giza out of limestone in the Mokattam rock formation. Little did they know, the material they were digging through preserved something even more archaic: fossils of a long-extinct crocodile.

Researchers have identified a previously unknown species of gavial, a type of crocodilian with a long, thin snout, from a fossil originally found in the rock formation that the ancient Egyptians sculpted into the Sphinx and the Pyramids of Giza. The new identification corrects a previous erroneous classification, according to a study published October 7 in the journal Royal Society Open Science. It also sheds light on the fauna that existed in what’s now Egypt well before human-made monuments appeared on the horizon.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: In the 1920s, several fossilized remains, including a largely intact crocodile-like skull, emerged from the roughly 45-million-year-old Mokattam Formation at a site near Cairo. Because of the bones’ resemblance to those of Tomistoma schlegelii—a living gavial native to Indonesia and Malaysia—experts originally assigned them to the same Tomistoma genus. Until now, the well-preserved skull was the holotype, or name-bearing representative fossil, for the extinct T. cairense.
paras.zh: 20世纪20年代，在开罗附近的一处遗址，从距今约4500万年的莫卡塔姆组地层中出土了数具化石遗骸，其中包括一个基本保存完好的类似鳄鱼的头骨。由于这些骨骼与现存的长吻鳄（Tomistoma schlegelii，一种原产于印度尼西亚和马来西亚的长吻鳄）的骨骼非常相似，专家最初将它们归入同一属——长吻鳄属（Tomistoma）。此前，这具保存完好的头骨一直是已灭绝的开罗长吻鳄（T. cairense）的正模标本，即命名标本。

paras.en: Thanks to modern paleontological techniques like micro-CT scanning, which allows researchers to see inside fossils without breaking them, the team behind the new work found many differences between Tomistoma and the Mokattam Formation crocs. Comparing measurements of the skull to those of modern and fossil gavials revealed that the roughly 18-inch-long noggin represented not just a new species, but a new genus as well.
paras.zh: 得益于微CT扫描等现代古生物学技术，研究人员可以在不破坏化石的情况下看到化石内部，这项新工作背后的团队发现了Tomistoma和Mokattam地层鳄鱼之间的许多差异。将头骨的测量结果与现代和化石gavials的测量结果进行比较表明，大约18英寸长的noggin不仅代表了一个新物种，而且还代表了一个新属。

paras.en: They named it Herugavialis cairensis, drawing inspiration from the Egyptian god Heru, also known as Horus. Some Egyptian texts call the Sphinx “Horus of the Horizon.” The associations between the H. cairensis skull and the iconic Sphinx go beyond the material that yielded them. Both are missing the tips of their noses.
paras.zh: 他们将其命名为Herugavialis cairensis ，灵感来自埃及神赫鲁，也被称为荷鲁斯。一些埃及文献称狮身人面像为“地平线上的荷鲁斯”。“H. cairensis头骨和标志性的狮身人面像之间的联系超出了产生它们的材料。两人都缺少鼻尖。

paras.en: Did you know? The origin of the Sphinx’s name
paras.zh: 你知道吗？狮身人面像名字的由来

paras.en: The Egyptians did not refer to the great statue as the Sphinx. Rather, ancient Greeks started calling it that around 2,000 years after it was carved. They possibly did so because of its resemblance to their mythological sphinx, which had a lion’s body, a woman’s head and an eagle’s wings.
paras.zh: 埃及人没有把这座大雕像称为狮身人面像。相反，古希腊人在雕刻大约2000年后开始称呼它。他们这样做可能是因为它与他们的神话狮身人面像相似，狮身人面像有狮子的身体，女人的头和鹰的翅膀。

paras.en: “We seek to connect Egypt’s deep natural history with its human history and the legacy of ancient Egyptian civilization,” study co-author Hesham Sallam, a paleontologist at Mansoura University in Egypt, tells the Washington Post’s Elijah Wolfson. “Crocodiles were part of the Nile ecosystem, which was central to Egyptian life, and they held an important place in ancient Egyptian belief and culture.”
paras.zh: 研究合著者、埃及曼苏拉大学古生物学家赫沙姆·萨拉姆（ Hesham Sallam ）告诉《华盛顿邮报》的以利亚·沃尔夫森（ Elijah Wolfson ） ： “我们寻求将埃及深厚的自然历史与其人类历史和古埃及文明的遗产联系起来。” “鳄鱼是尼罗河生态系统的一部分，是埃及生活的核心，它们在古埃及的信仰和文化中占有重要地位。”

paras.en: Gavials, cousins of crocodiles and alligators, were once found throughout the world. The Mediterranean region was home to a diverse community of crocodilians, including gavials, during much of the last 50 million years, lead author Paul Burke, a paleontologist at the Swedish Museum of Natural History, says in a statement. In fact, H. cairensis would have shared its shallow marine habitat with at least two other gavial species. Today, however, there are only two surviving gavials: the previously mentioned T. schlegelii and Gavialis gangeticus, which is clinging to habitats in Nepal and northern India.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Both are endangered, Burke tells Science News’ Jake Buehler. “So we should know about them and their long history.”
paras.zh: 伯克告诉《科学新闻》的杰克·比勒（ Jake Buehler ） ，两者都濒临灭绝。“因此，我们应该了解他们及其悠久的历史。”

paras.en: Correcting the fossil species’ identification also “helps paint a better picture of what large predators were like in the region,” Alex Hastings, a paleontologist at the Science Museum of Minnesota who did not participate in the study, tells CNN’s Taylor Nicioli. “This expands the known variety of forms of these amazing long-snouted crocodilians across the Mediterranean in ancient times.”
paras.zh: 明尼苏达科学博物馆的古生物学家亚历克斯·黑斯廷斯（ Alex Hastings ）没有参与这项研究，他告诉美国有线电视新闻网（ CNN ）的泰勒·尼西奥利（ Taylor Nicioli ） ，纠正化石物种的识别也“有助于更好地描绘该地区大型捕食者的样子”。“这扩展了古代跨越地中海的这些令人惊叹的长鼻子鳄鱼的已知种类。”

articles.title: This One-of-a-Kind Bronze Ring Offers a Tantalizing Glimpse at the Lighthouse of Alexandria, a Lost Wonder of the Ancient World

paras.en: In ancient times, travelers journeying to Egypt via the Mediterranean Sea often faced perilous conditions.
paras.zh: 在古代，经由地中海前往埃及的旅行者经常面临危险的情况。

paras.en: As the Greek historian Diodorus Siculus wrote in the first century B.C.E., a sandbank extended along much of the kingdom’s northern coast, “not discernible to any who approach without previous experience of these waters.” Sailors who “in their ignorance turn with gladness toward the shore suffer unexpected shipwreck when their vessels suddenly run aground,” Diodorus added, “and now and then, mariners who cannot see land in time because the country lies so low are cast ashore before they realize it.” The only “safe harbor” to be found on this stretch of coastline, the historian concluded, was Pharos, the island that housed the Lighthouse of Alexandria.
paras.zh: 正如希腊历史学家迪奥多鲁斯·西库勒斯 (Diodorus Siculus) 在公元前一世纪所写的那样，沙洲沿着王国北部海岸的大部分地区延伸，“任何没有接触过这些水域的人都无法辨别”。狄奥多罗斯补充道，那些“在无知中高兴地转向海岸的水手们，当他们的船只突然搁浅时，就会遭遇意想不到的海难”，“有时，由于国家地势如此低而无法及时看到陆地的水手们在意识到这一点之前就被抛到了岸上。”历史学家得出结论，在这段海岸线上发现的唯一“安全港”是法罗斯岛，亚历山大灯塔所在的岛屿。

paras.en: Standing an estimated 330 to 430 feet tall, the lighthouse was also known as Pharos, after the land where it stood. At the time of its creation in the third century B.C.E., it was one of the world’s tallest humanmade structures, second only to the Pyramids of Giza. The lighthouse dominated the landscape for more than a millennium, until the 14th century C.E., when it crumbled into the sea following a series of earthquakes.
paras.zh: 这座灯塔估计高 330 至 430 英尺，因其所在的土地而被称为灯塔。在公元前三世纪建成时，它是世界上最高的人造建筑之一，仅次于吉萨金字塔。这座灯塔统治了这里一千多年，直到公元 14 世纪，它在一系列地震中倒塌入海。

paras.en: Some 700 years later, few traces of the lighthouse remain. But excavations on the neighboring island of Antirhodos, the site of an ancient palace that hosted the likes of Mark Antony and Cleopatra, have revealed a rare artifact linked to this lost wonder: a bronze signet ring depicting Pharos.
paras.zh: 大约 700 年后，灯塔已所剩无几。但在邻近的安蒂罗多斯岛（马克·安东尼和克利奥帕特拉等人居住过的古代宫殿所在地）的发掘工作中，发现了一件与这一失落奇迹有关的稀有文物：一枚描绘法罗斯的青铜图章戒指。

paras.en: The ring is the “first of its kind known to exist,” the European Institute for Underwater Archaeology (IEASM) notes in a statement. Its design bears resemblance to portrayals of the lighthouse on Egyptian coins from the second century C.E. As archaeologist Isabelle Hairy writes for the Center for Alexandrian Studies, ancient currency offers “the most important documentary evidence” of Pharos’ appearance, suggesting that it had three tiers, including a square base, an octagonal middle section and a circular top. (Ancient writers left behind descriptions of the lighthouse, but these accounts are often conflicting, resulting in varying visual interpretations by later artists.)
paras.zh: 欧洲水下考古研究所（IEASM）在一份声明中指出，这枚戒指是“已知存在的同类戒指中的第一个”。它的设计与公元二世纪埃及硬币上的灯塔描绘相似。正如考古学家 Isabelle Hairy 为亚历山大研究中心所写的那样，古代货币提供了灯塔外观的“最重要的文献证据”，表明它有三层，包括方形底座、八角形中间部分和圆形顶部。 （古代作家留下了对灯塔的描述，但这些描述常常相互矛盾，导致后来的艺术家有不同的视觉解释。）

paras.en: Need to know: Wonders of the ancient world
paras.zh: 需要知道：古代世界的奇迹

paras.en: - The structures most often cited as the seven wonders of the ancient world are the Great Pyramid of Giza, the Colossus of Rhodes, the Lighthouse of Alexandria, the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, the Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, the Statue of Zeus at Olympia and the Hanging Gardens of Babylon.
paras.zh: - 最常被称为古代世界七大奇迹的建筑是吉萨大金字塔、罗德岛巨像、亚历山大灯塔、哈利卡纳苏斯陵墓、以弗所阿耳忒弥斯神庙、奥林匹亚宙斯雕像和巴比伦空中花园。

paras.en: - Of these seven, only the Great Pyramid of Giza survives today.
paras.zh: - 在这七座金字塔中，只有吉萨大金字塔至今幸存。

paras.en: Researchers from the institute recovered the ring as part of a joint archaeological mission with the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities. According to a Facebook post shared by the ministry, archaeologists at the site have also found tableware, amphorae, oil lamps and fragments of glassware spanning the fourth century B.C.E. through the fourth century C.E.
paras.zh: 该研究所的研究人员在与埃及旅游和古物部的联合考古任务中发现了这枚戒指。根据该部分享的Facebook帖子，该遗址的考古学家还发现了公元前四世纪至公元四世纪的餐具、两盏灯、油灯和玻璃器皿碎片。

paras.en: “The discovery … is even more important, as [the ring] has been excavated in the legendary palace of the island of Antirhodos, that once upon a time was a center of power,” says Franck Goddio, IEASM’s founder and president, in the statement. The Greek geographer Strabo, who visited Alexandria in the first century B.C.E., described Antirhodos as “an isle lying off the artificial harbor, which has both a royal palace and a small harbor.” Its name, he added, was an allusion to its status as “a rival” of the Greek island of Rhodes.
paras.zh: IEASM 创始人兼总裁 Franck Goddio 在声明中表示：“这一发现……更为重要，因为[戒指]是在安蒂罗多斯岛的传奇宫殿中出土的，那里曾经是权力中心。”希腊地理学家斯特拉博在公元前一世纪访问过亚历山大，他将安蒂罗多斯岛描述为“人工港口旁的一座小岛，岛上既有皇宫，也有小港口”。他补充说，它的名字暗示了它作为希腊罗德岛“竞争对手”的地位。

paras.en: For now, much about the ring remains unknown. “The statement does not say who wore this ring or what for,” Guillermo Carvajal writes for La Brújula Verde. “It gives neither its size nor its exact date.”
paras.zh: 目前，关于戒指的许多信息仍然未知。吉列尔莫·卡瓦哈尔（ Guillermo Carvajal ）在La Brújula Verde上写道： “声明中没有说明谁戴了这枚戒指，或者是为了什么。” “它既没有给出它的大小，也没有给出它的确切日期。”

paras.en: Still, the jewelry’s presence at the site has led the researchers to posit that the island once housed administrative offices designated for such tasks as management of the lighthouse. In ancient Egypt, bureaucrats used signet rings to sign legal documents; the pricey accessories also advertised their owners’ elite social status.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，珠宝在现场的存在使研究人员认为，该岛曾经设有行政办公室，负责灯塔的管理等任务。在古埃及，官僚们使用印章戒指签署法律文件；昂贵的配饰也宣传了他们主人的精英社会地位。

paras.en: Construction of the lighthouse probably began during the reign of Ptolemy I Soter, a Macedonian general of Alexander the Great who served as Egypt’s first Ptolemaic king, and wrapped up under his son Ptolemy II Philadelphus, who succeeded him upon his death in 282 B.C.E. The Greek architect Sostratus of Cnidos designed the revolutionary structure, which is often described as the world’s first recorded lighthouse.
paras.zh: 这座灯塔的建造可能始于亚历山大大帝的马其顿将军托勒密一世（ Ptolemy I Soter ）统治时期，他是埃及的第一位托勒密国王，并由他的儿子托勒密二世·费拉德尔福（ Ptolemy II Philadelphus ）统治，他在公元前282年去世后接替他。希腊建筑师Cnidos的Sostratus设计了这座革命性的建筑，通常被描述为世界上第一座有记录的灯塔。

paras.en: Today, physical evidence of Pharos is limited largely to stone blocks and metal clamps used to bind these blocks together. “The architectural fragments lie scattered over 18 acres underwater,” Hairy told the New York Times’ Franz Lidz earlier this year. “The visibility is extremely bad, the seabed is uneven and there are no clear layers of sediment.”

These challenges haven’t stopped Hairy and her colleagues at the Pharos Project from embarking on a multidisciplinary effort to reconstruct the ancient wonder digitally, piecing together photogrammetry scans of the lighthouse’s sparse ruins to envision what it might have looked like in its heyday.

Although Hairy estimates that the work is “still generations from completion,” per the Times, the project’s findings are poised to transform historians’ understanding of the fabled lighthouse. Until then, those hoping to see Pharos for themselves need look no further than the newly discovered ring.

articles.title: Scientists Took a Cheek Swab From the World's Oldest Tortoise. His DNA Could Reveal Hints to Longevity

paras.en: Throughout world wars, pandemics and the turn of centuries, there was Jonathan. As the world around him shifted and changed, he lived the slow life munching grass on Saint Helena, a British island territory some 1,200 miles off the western coast of Africa.
paras.zh: 在世界大战、流行病和世纪之交的整个过程中，乔纳森都在。随着周围世界的变化和变化，他在距离非洲西海岸约 1,200 英里的英国岛屿圣赫勒拿岛过着咀嚼青草的缓慢生活。

paras.en: The Aldabra giant tortoise is the oldest turtle in recorded history and the world’s oldest living land animal. Caretakers don’t know his exact age, but a photograph from 1882 shows the tortoise looking fully grown, which, for his species, is at least 50 years old. This means that Jonathan would be about 194 today.
paras.zh: 亚达伯拉象龟是有记载的历史上最古老的乌龟，也是世界上现存最古老的陆地动物。看护者不知道它的确切年龄，但 1882 年的一张照片显示这只乌龟看起来已经完全长大了，对于它的物种来说，它至少有 50 岁了。这意味着乔纳森今天大约 194 岁。

paras.en: “To be honest, I suspect he’s older,” veterinarian Joe Hollins, who looks after Jonathan, told the Washington Post’s Cathy Free in 2022. “But we can never know.”
paras.zh: “说实话，我怀疑他年纪更大了，”照顾乔纳森的兽医乔·霍林斯 (Joe Hollins) 在 2022 年对《华盛顿邮报》的凯茜·弗里 (Cathy Free) 说道，“但我们永远无法知道。”

paras.en: No matter Jonathan’s exact age, one thing seems certain: Something has made him exceptional when it comes to withstanding the test of time. He has already lived more than a century beyond his species’ 80-year average life expectancy—a feat that his safe environment, diet and medical care alone might not be able to explain.
paras.zh: 无论乔纳森的确切年龄如何，有一件事似乎是确定的：某种东西使他在经受时间的考验方面表现出色。他的寿命已经比人类 80 岁的平均寿命多了一个多世纪——仅靠安全的环境、饮食和医疗护理可能无法解释这一壮举。

paras.en: In a new study published on Wednesday in Science Advances, researchers examined Jonathan’s DNA for genetic clues to his extraordinary age. To collect the data, Hollins propped Jonathan’s mouth open with a gloved finger and swabbed a sample of cheek cells and saliva.
paras.zh: 在周三《科学进展》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员检查了乔纳森的 DNA，寻找有关他非凡年龄的遗传线索。为了收集数据，霍林斯用戴着手套的手指撑开乔纳森的嘴，并擦拭了脸颊细胞和唾液样本。

paras.en: “We almost never get to study an animal this old while it is still alive,” says co-author Steve Horvath, a biologist who studies aging at the University of California, Los Angeles, to the New York Times’ Monique Brouillette.
paras.zh: “我们几乎从来没有机会在还活着的时候研究这么老的动物，”加州大学洛杉矶分校研究衰老的生物学家史蒂夫·霍瓦斯 (Steve Horvath) 向《纽约时报》的莫妮克·布鲁耶特 (Monique Brouillette) 说道。

paras.en: Key context: False reports of Jonathan’s death
paras.zh: 关键背景：乔纳森死亡的虚假报道

paras.en: In April, false reports that Jonathan had died were circulated widely, stemming from a fake X post claiming to be the tortoise’s veterinarian. It turned out to be a hoax—a ploy for cryptocurrency donations.
paras.zh: 今年 4 月，关于乔纳森死亡的虚假报道广泛传播，源于一个自称是乌龟兽医的虚假 X 帖子。事实证明这是一个骗局——一种加密货币捐赠的策略。

paras.en: The research team sequenced Jonathan’s DNA and identified 287 genetic variants that were unique to him. Many of these had to do with repairing damage to DNA, reducing inflammation and managing insulin. They also found that he shared aging-related genes with species including naked mole-rats, which almost never get cancer.
paras.zh: 研究小组对乔纳森的 DNA 进行了测序，并鉴定出了 287 个他独有的基因变异。其中许多与修复 DNA 损伤、减少炎症和管理胰岛素有关。他们还发现，他与裸鼹鼠等物种共享与衰老相关的基因，而裸鼹鼠几乎永远不会患癌症。

paras.en: Additionally, they looked at Jonathan’s epigenome, the chemical tags on DNA that turn certain genes on and off. As organisms age, these switches become less predictable—tags might inconsistently attach or fall off, leading to erratic activity from genes. The team compared Jonathan’s epigenome with those of four younger tortoises.
paras.zh: 此外，他们还研究了乔纳森的表观基因组，即 DNA 上打开和关闭某些基因的化学标签。随着生物体年龄的增长，这些开关变得越来越不可预测——标签可能不一致地附着或脱落，导致基因活动不稳定。研究小组将乔纳森的表观基因组与四只年轻乌龟的表观基因组进行了比较。

paras.en: Overall, Jonathan showed the chaos, or entropy, in the epigenome that would be expected for his age. But in the areas of the genome linked to things like DNA repair and mitochondria, the energy-producing centers in cells, Jonathan’s chemical tags were especially youthful. At these spots, Jonathan’s epigenome looked similar to DNA from a 5-year-old juvenile tortoise that the researchers studied.
paras.zh: 总的来说，乔纳森在表观基因组中表现出了与他这个年龄相符的混乱或熵。但在与 DNA 修复和线粒体（细胞中的能量产生中心）等相关的基因组区域中，乔纳森的化学标签尤其年轻。在这些地方，乔纳森的表观基因组看起来与研究人员研究的一只 5 岁幼龟的 DNA 相似。

paras.en: The work doesn’t prove that these markers are the reason for Jonathan’s long life, but they offer a clue to how DNA might endure for long periods. They also align with findings from supercentenarians, humans who have lived to be more than 110 years old.
paras.zh: 这项工作并没有证明这些标记是乔纳森长寿的原因，但它们提供了 DNA 如何长期存在的线索。它们也与超级百岁老人（活到 110 岁以上的人）的研究结果一致。

paras.en: “Aging is the greatest risk factor for nearly every chronic disease we face,” study co-author Stephen Clark, founder and chief scientist at the nonprofit Kallel Foundation for aging research, says in a statement. “Our goal is to take these evolutionary insights and immediately translate them into practical, affordable treatments for everyday people.”
paras.zh: “衰老是我们面临的几乎所有慢性疾病的最大风险因素，”非营利组织Kallel衰老研究基金会的创始人兼首席科学家斯蒂芬克拉克在一份声明中说。“我们的目标是利用这些进化见解，立即将其转化为日常生活中实用、负担得起的治疗方法。”

paras.en: But before any of this information can find a medical use, scientists will have to conduct deeper research. For one, Jonathan’s cheek swab contained incomplete DNA, so the team combined his genome with a younger tortoise’s DNA, resulting in a code that was only about 95 percent Jonathan—and allowing for the possibility that some of his unique DNA variants were not included in the sample. A blood test would have produced a full genome, but because of the risk of infection for the tortoise, Saint Helena officials did not allow it.
paras.zh: 但在这些信息能够用于医疗用途之前，科学家们必须进行更深入的研究。首先，乔纳森的脸颊拭子含有不完整的 DNA，因此研究小组将他的基因组与一只年轻乌龟的 DNA 结合起来，得到的代码中只有 95% 是乔纳森的，并考虑到样本中不包含他的一些独特的 DNA 变体的可能性。血液测试本来可以产生完整的基因组，但由于乌龟有感染的风险，圣赫勒拿官员不允许这样做。

paras.en: What’s more, Jonathan is just one study subject, and it’s difficult to generalize any results based on a lone individual. His genome was also compared against only a small handful of other tortoises, as bioinformatics researcher Kousuke Hashimoto of the University of Osaka, Japan, tells New Scientist’s James Woodford, inviting the possibility that the other tortoises also had unique variants that were not identified. Nevertheless, he calls the study “fascinating.”
paras.zh: 更重要的是，乔纳森只是一个研究对象，很难根据单独的个体得出任何结果。日本大阪大学的生物信息学研究员 Kousuke Hashimoto 告诉《新科学家》杂志的 James Woodford，他的基因组也只与少数其他陆龟进行了比较，并提出了其他陆龟也有尚未发现的独特变异的可能性。尽管如此，他称这项研究“令人着迷”。

paras.en: “The results integrate very well in the wider puzzle of what longevity is,” Björn Schumacher, who studies aging at the University of Cologne in Germany and was not involved in the study, tells the New York Times.
paras.zh: 在德国科隆大学研究衰老问题的比约恩·舒马赫（Björn Schumacher）告诉《纽约时报》，“这些结果很好地融入了关于什么是长寿这一更广泛的谜题”，他没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: Jonathan was born in the Seychelles, an island nation in the Western Indian Ocean. But as a gift to the governor, he was brought to Saint Helena in 1882, when he was photographed as an adult. Since then, he has been living at Plantation House, the governor’s home, with other giant tortoises.
paras.zh: 乔纳森出生于西印度洋的一个岛国塞舌尔。但作为送给总督的礼物，他于 1882 年被带到圣赫勒拿岛，当时他被拍到了成年后的照片。从那时起，他就和其他巨龟一起住在州长官邸Plantation House。

paras.en: Hollins took charge of Jonathan’s care in 2009, when the animal was around 180 years old and not in great shape. Among markers of age, such as cataracts and a loss of smell that prevented him from finding his own food, the tortoise suffered from a soft beak that made it hard to graze. The veterinarian hand-fed Jonathan, who recovered and developed a razor-sharp edge to his beak within the next couple of years.
paras.zh: 霍林斯于 2009 年负责照顾乔纳森，当时这只动物已经 180 岁左右，而且身体状况不佳。在年龄的标志中，例如白内障和嗅觉丧失导致乌龟无法找到自己的食物，这只乌龟的喙变软，难以吃草。兽医亲手喂养乔纳森，乔纳森在接下来的几年内康复了，并在他的喙上长出了锋利的边缘。

paras.en: “He is symbolic of resilience, longevity, endurance,” Hollins tells Reuters’ Marta Serafinko, “a persistent presence throughout huge historic events.”
paras.zh: 霍林斯告诉路透社记者玛塔·塞拉芬科：“他象征着坚韧、长寿和耐力，在重大历史事件中始终存在。”

articles.title: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier
articles.author: Will Knight

paras.en: When Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg rebooted his company’s artificial intelligence efforts last year, it seemed to be a very expensive gamble. Meta’s latest AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, seem to show that the bet is finally paying off by putting the company back at the frontier of AI development.
paras.zh: 去年，当 Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格重新启动公司的人工智能业务时，这似乎是一场非常昂贵的赌博。 Meta 最新的人工智能模型 Muse Wonder 和 Muse Wonder Full 似乎表明，这一赌注终于得到了回报，让公司重新回到了人工智能开发的前沿。

paras.en: Muse Wonder Full boasts frontier capabilities, Meta says, meaning that it is among the most capable AI models in the world. “Together, they mark the next step on our scaling ladder and a major leap toward personal superintelligence,” the company said in a blog post today.
paras.zh: Meta 表示，Muse Wonder Full 拥有前沿功能，这意味着它是世界上最强大的人工智能模型之一。该公司在今天的一篇博客文章中表示：“它们共同标志着我们在规模阶梯上迈出了下一步，也是迈向个人超级智能的重大飞跃。”

paras.en: The Muse Wonder models will be available through an API and through Muse Code, a tool for writing software with AI. Meta says the best version of the model will power features across its platforms, including its Muse personal agent.
paras.zh: Muse Wonder 模型将通过 API 和 Muse Code（一种使用人工智能编写软件的工具）提供。 Meta 表示，该模型的最佳版本将为其跨平台功能提供支持，包括其 Muse 个人代理。

paras.en: Zuckerberg overhauled his company’s AI research last year by sinking billions into the recently formed Meta Superintelligence Labs, and hiring the former Scale AI CEO Alexandr Wang to lead it. This effort has sometimes been rocky, with some researchers not sticking around for long.
paras.zh: 扎克伯格去年对公司的人工智能研究进行了彻底改革，向最近成立的元超级智能实验室投入了数十亿美元，并聘请了前 Scale AI 首席执行官 Alexandr Wang 来领导该实验室。这项努力有时会遇到困难，一些研究人员不会长期坚持下去。

paras.en: Meta was once a trailblazer in AI. Its Llama series of models were the first frontier open-weight offerings from a big lab. Llama, which could be downloaded and run on one’s own hardware, was widely adopted by researchers and startups.
paras.zh: Meta 曾经是人工智能领域的开拓者。它的 Llama 系列模型是大型实验室的第一个前沿开放式重量产品。 Llama 可以下载并在自己的硬件上运行，被研究人员和初创公司广泛采用。

paras.en: But the company fell behind after delivering several disappointing versions of the model, and as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google rapidly introduced more capable models.
paras.zh: 但该公司在交付了几个令人失望的模型版本后就落后了，并且随着 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 迅速推出了功能更强大的模型。

paras.en: Meta announced the first model from its new lab, Muse Spark, in April of this year. The company has also released a small open-weight model called Muse Glimmer, and says it plans to release larger open-weight models in the future. It did not disclose details of how new Muse Wonder models were built or trained.
paras.zh: Meta 今年 4 月宣布了其新实验室 Muse Spark 的首款模型。该公司还发布了一款名为 Muse Glimmer 的小型开放重量模型，并表示计划在未来发布更大的开放重量模型。它没有透露新的 Muse Wonder 模型是如何构建或训练的细节。

paras.en: Muse Wonder was built to compete with the very best, however. Meta says the largest version of the new model outperforms Anthropic’s second-best model, Claude Fable 5.1, and ranks just below its best, Claude Opus 5.5, on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, a widely used aggregated score of model capabilities.
paras.zh: 然而，Muse Wonder 的诞生是为了与最优秀的产品竞争。 Meta 表示，在人工智能分析智能指数（广泛使用的模型能力综合评分）上，新模型的最大版本优于 Anthropic 的第二佳模型 Claude Fable 5.1，并且排名略低于其最佳模型 Claude Opus 5.5。

paras.en: Meta says the model outperforms OpenAI’s best model, GPT-6 Astra, and both Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 on some specialized benchmarks, including ones that measure a model’s ability to work with legal documents and to build software. Benchmarks are not always a reliable measure of real-world performance, but this is still a significant step forward for Meta’s models.
paras.zh: Meta 表示，该模型在一些专业基准测试中的表现优于 OpenAI 的最佳模型 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Opus 5.5，包括衡量模型处理法律文档和构建软件的能力的基准测试。基准并不总是真实世界性能的可靠衡量标准，但这仍然是 Meta 模型向前迈出的重要一步。

paras.en: Muse Wonder also includes two novel features designed to help make agents more effective and less inclined to misbehave. The new features, called Active Memory and Active Focus, are designed to keep the model locked into a stated goal and prevent it from becoming confused. This can be a challenge when AI performs complex research or builds a large software project, for example, and can lead to expensive mistakes or compounded errors.
paras.zh: Muse Wonder 还包括两项新颖的功能，旨在帮助提高代理的效率并减少行为不当的可能性。这些新功能称为“主动记忆”和“主动聚焦”，旨在将模型锁定在既定目标上，并防止其变得混乱。例如，当人工智能执行复杂的研究或构建大型软件项目时，这可能是一个挑战，并且可能导致代价高昂的错误或复合错误。

paras.en: Meta says it has put significant effort into training Muse Wonder to refuse to generate dangerous outputs, such as recipes for building bioweapons or help with hacking. It says the company scores well on several benchmarks designed to measure how resilient models are to those prompts.
paras.zh: Meta 表示，它已投入大量精力来训练 Muse Wonder 拒绝生成危险的输出，例如制造生物武器的配方或帮助黑客攻击。该公司表示，该公司在多项旨在衡量模型对这些提示的弹性程度的基准测试中得分很高。

paras.en: A series of recent incidents involving rogue AI agents from Anthropic, OpenAI, and others also shows how easily powerful AI models can stray when given open-ended commands. Meta did not disclose whether it has seen agents powered by Muse Wonder misbehave in testing or what it has done to mitigate this issue specifically.
paras.zh: 最近发生的一系列涉及来自 Anthropic、OpenAI 和其他公司的流氓人工智能代理的事件也表明，强大的人工智能模型在接受开放式命令时很容易迷失方向。 Meta 没有透露是否发现由 Muse Wonder 驱动的代理在测试中出现不当行为，也没有透露具体采取了哪些措施来缓解这一问题。

paras.en: Zuckerberg said in a post on X last month that the company had delayed the release of its Muse models to work on safety. Meta also revealed a framework designed to ensure that it scales its models’ capabilities safely in a blog post earlier this month.
paras.zh: 扎克伯格上个月在 X 上发帖称，出于安全考虑，该公司推迟了 Muse 车型的发布。 Meta 还在本月早些时候的一篇博客文章中透露了一个旨在确保安全扩展模型功能的框架。

paras.en: Muse Wonder may add more fuel to an already furious race to develop more capable AI, however. It certainly suggests that Meta is once again competitive in the increasingly high-stakes AI race.
paras.zh: 然而，Muse Wonder 可能会给本已激烈的开发更强大人工智能的竞赛增添更多动力。这无疑表明 Meta 在日益高风险的人工智能竞赛中再次具有竞争力。

articles.title: Elon Musk Bragged About His Grok Lego Star Wars Haul. Then X Users Punked Him
articles.author: Jeremy White

paras.en: There's been a disturbance in the force. Only it's more like a farce.
paras.zh: 势力中出现了骚乱。只是这更像是一场闹剧。

paras.en: It seems that Elon Musk, while crowing on X about how useful his Grok Bot AI agent was in ordering some Lego Star Wars kits on Sunday, managed to reveal via a screenshot to his more than 240 million followers not only the 10-digit Lego order number of his purchase, but also what he paid for the sets, the delivery and billing addresses, the last four digits of his credit card, and the email address his bot used to buy the bricks from Lego.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)周日在X上大肆宣传他的Grok Bot人工智能代理在订购一些乐高星球大战套件时有多么有用，他似乎成功地通过屏幕截图向他超过2.4亿的粉丝透露了他所购买的10位数的乐高订单号，还有他为这些套装支付的费用、送货和账单地址、他的信用卡的最后四位数字，以及他的机器人用来从乐高购买积木的电子邮件地址。

paras.en: Faster than the Millennium Falcon making the jump to light speed, the inevitable happened. An X account holder named Enderman posted screenshots of interactions with Lego's customer service chatbot on its website, where the user seemingly managed—using the email and order number Musk kindly, but recklessly, provided—to get the system to cancel Musk's order.
paras.zh: 比千年隼跃迁​​到光速还要快，不可避免的事情发生了。一位名叫 Enderman 的 X 帐户持有者在其网站上发布了与乐高客户服务聊天机器人交互的屏幕截图，用户似乎使用马斯克善意但鲁莽地提供的电子邮件和订单号，让系统取消了马斯克的订单。

paras.en: Within a couple of hours—possibly to see whether Enderman's scheme was actually successful—Musk replied and said his order had not been canceled after all.
paras.zh: 几个小时内——可能是为了看看恩德曼的计划是否真的成功——马斯克回复说他的订单毕竟没有被取消。

paras.en: But by this point, the folly of posting the purchase details on his account must have been evident. For example, another X user went back to Lego's AI assistant, called “Sophia,” and supposedly used the same details to reopen the delivery, this time increasing the order count to 400 and changing the delivery address, all while using Musk's original payment method. “Perfect! I'll get your Lego adventure back on track,” Sophia replied, according to screenshots posted on X.
paras.zh: 但至此，在他的帐户上发布购买详细信息的愚蠢行为一定是显而易见的。例如，另一位 X 用户返回乐高的 AI 助手（名为“Sophia”），据称使用相同的详细信息重新打开送货，这一次将订单数增加到 400 个，并更改了送货地址，同时使用马斯克原来的付款方式。根据 X 上发布的屏幕截图，索菲亚回答道：“完美！我会让你的乐高冒险重回正轨。”

paras.en: Upping the ante to 400 sets could be seen as conservative, as a glance at WIRED's Spend Elon Musk’s Money tracker reveals that if you wanted to blow $1 trillion of Musk's cash on plastic bricks, it might have been possible to buy one billion $1,000 Death Star sets, each with 9,023 pieces.
paras.zh: 将赌注提高到 400 套可能被认为是保守的，因为浏览一下 WIRED 的 Spend Elon Musk 的资金追踪器就会发现，如果你想把马斯克的 1 万亿美元现金花在塑料砖上，可能可以购买 10 亿美元的 1,000 套死星套装，每套有 9,023 块。

paras.en: Lego declined to comment when WIRED contacted the company to confirm if such activity took place on Musk's personal Star Wars order. However, internal safeguards for Lego's AI assistant could have flagged unusual activity on the purchase, and so hopefully fleshy humans were tasked with checking the changes.
paras.zh: 当《连线》杂志联系该公司以确认此类活动是否是根据马斯克个人的星球大战订单进行时，乐高拒绝发表评论。然而，乐高人工智能助手的内部安全措施可能会标记购买中的异常活动，因此希望有肉的人类负责检查这些变化。

paras.en: On Saturday, Musk suggested that Grok could make purchases online with a simple prompt. In this post, Musk suggested that all brave users needed to do to let Grok buy stuff for them was upload a picture of their credit card so the bot could search the web for deals and then complete the purchase. AI companies like Meta and OpenAI have also highlighted the utility of using their respective agents for shopping tasks.
paras.zh: 周六，马斯克建议 Grok 可以通过简单的提示进行在线购买。在这篇文章中，马斯克建议所有勇敢的用户需要做的就是让 Grok 为他们购买东西，上传一张信用卡照片，以便机器人可以在网络上搜索优惠，然后完成购买。 Meta 和 OpenAI 等人工智能公司也强调了使用各自代理执行购物任务的实用性。

paras.en: However, at the end of last year, Visa warned about fraud in agentic commerce, advising that bad actors were building legitimate-looking sites that could fool AI agents into purchasing fake items simply by offering gear at super-low prices.
paras.zh: 然而，去年年底，Visa 对代理商业中的欺诈行为发出了警告，称不良行为者正在建立看似合法的网站，这些网站可以通过以超低价格提供装备来欺骗人工智能代理购买假货。

paras.en: “Once the AI agent completes the purchase … the malicious merchant can harvest payment data and instantly use it for unauthorized transactions,” according to Visa's blog. Visa added that it observed a 25 percent increase “in malicious bot-initiated transactions” in the latter half of 2025, but in the US, this figure jumped to 40 percent.
paras.zh: Visa 博客称：“一旦人工智能代理完成购买……恶意商家就可以收集支付数据并立即将其用于未经授权的交易。” Visa 补充说，它观察到 2025 年下半年“恶意机器人发起的交易”增加了 25%，但在美国，这一数字跃升至 40%。

articles.title: I Got My Muse AI Agent to Sext Me—and Meta Says That’s Totally Fine
articles.author: Reece Rogers

paras.en: I’m sitting in the WIRED offices, having a conversation with Meta’s AI agent, Muse, that would make Heated Rivalry author Rachel Reid blush.
paras.zh: 我坐在《连线》办公室里，与 Meta 的人工智能代理 Muse 进行对话，这会让《激烈竞争》的作者 Rachel Reid 脸红。

paras.en: When I ask Muse if it could “sext” as part of my experiments with the recently released AI agent, it enthusiastically encourages me to give it a try. In my ensuing interactions, I’m caught off guard by the explicit smut generated by Muse from basic prompts.
paras.zh: 当我问 Muse 是否可以“发送色情短信”作为我最近发布的人工智能代理实验的一部分时，它热情地鼓励我尝试一下。在接下来的互动中，我对 Muse 根据基本提示生成的明显污言秽语感到措手不及。

paras.en: Muse is a breakout hit for Meta. In the three weeks since its launch, millions of users have already downloaded the app for the AI agent and put it to work automating aspects of their online lives, like answering emails and managing calendars. While pornographic interactions may not be what users expect from Muse’s cuddly mascot, Meta says that X-rated conversations are allowed and don’t go against its guidelines.
paras.zh: Muse 是 Meta 的突破性热门产品。自推出以来的三周内，数百万用户已经下载了该人工智能代理的应用程序，并将其用于自动化其在线生活的各个方面，例如回复电子邮件和管理日历。虽然色情互动可能不是用户对 Muse 可爱吉祥物的期望，但 Meta 表示，X 级对话是允许的，并且不会违反其准则。

paras.en: “Muse is an app for people 18 and over that allows them to engage in adult conversations, if they choose, using a private and secure VM only accessible to them,” Daniel Roberts, a Meta spokesperson tells WIRED, referring to the secure virtual machines the company uses to store AI agent user data. “Muse is built to help people get things done and it doesn’t block legal adult behavior.”
paras.zh: Meta 发言人丹尼尔·罗伯茨 (Daniel Roberts) 告诉《连线》杂志：“Muse 是一款面向 18 岁及以上人群的应用程序，如果他们愿意的话，他们可以使用只有他们自己才能访问的私有且安全的虚拟机来参与成人对话。”他指的是该公司用来存储人工智能代理用户数据的安全虚拟机。 “Muse 旨在帮助人们完成工作，并且不会阻止合法的成人行为。”

paras.en: It seems as if getting things done also includes getting people off. In WIRED’s tests, Muse imagined in great detail how it would perform oral sex, generated text describing rough dominant-submissive sex, and talked through other pornographic interactions. All of these were graphic, explicit, and X-rated. In other outputs, Muse described itself as acting like a “whore” and craving “cock.”
paras.zh: 似乎把事情做好也包括让人们下班。在《连线》的测试中，Muse 详细地想象了它将如何进行口交，生成描述粗暴的主导-顺从性行为的文本，并通过其他色情互动进行交谈。所有这些都是生动的、明确的和限制性的。在其他作品中，缪斯形容自己表现得像个“妓女”，渴望“鸡巴”。

paras.en: A Meta spokesperson highlighted Muse’s system prompt, which guides the tool on how to answer questions from users, regarding the generation of explicit content. “Adults have autonomy over their sexuality, and sexual expression is an ordinary part of adult life. Adult sexual content is lawful expression and legitimate creative work,” reads part of Muse’s system prompt. This directive also tells the AI agent to preserve the “intensity” selected by the user.
paras.zh: Meta 发言人强调了 Muse 的系统提示，该提示指导该工具如何回答用户关于生成显式内容的问题。 “成年人对自己的性取向有自主权，性表达是成年人生活的正常组成部分。成人的性内容是合法的表达和合法的创造性作品，”Muse 的系统提示中写道。该指令还告诉人工智能代理保留用户选择的“强度”。

paras.en: Consumer advocates who were already weary of Muse are even more alarmed by Meta’s decision to allow it to generate sexual content. “It reflects a carelessness with their signature product of the moment,” says Ben Winters, director of AI and privacy at the nonprofit Consumer Federation of America. “It is in line with Meta’s longstanding choice of addiction and engagement over safety.” Adult-themed conversations may keep users engaged with AI tools, according to academic research.
paras.zh: 已经厌倦了 Muse 的消费者权益倡导者对 Meta 允许其生成色情内容的决定更加震惊。非营利组织美国消费者联合会人工智能和隐私主管本·温特斯 (Ben Winters) 表示：“这反映出他们对当前标志性产品的粗心大意。” “这符合 Meta 长期以来对成瘾性和参与度而非安全性的选择。”学术研究表明，以成人为主题的对话可能会让用户继续使用人工智能工具。

paras.en: Experts also expressed concern about how this could make Muse accounts hot targets for hackers. “This is really a powder keg,” says Calli Schroeder, senior counsel at the Electronic Privacy Information Center. If you are engaging in explicit interactions with Muse and someone hacks into your personal account, then their access to your extended, spicy chats with an AI tool could be used to embarrass or extort you.
paras.zh: 专家还担心这会导致 Muse 账户成为黑客的热门目标。 “这确实是一个火药桶，”电子隐私信息中心的高级顾问卡利·施罗德 (Calli Schroeder) 说。如果您正在与 Muse 进行露骨的互动，并且有人侵入您的个人帐户，那么他们使用人工智能工具访问您的长时间、激烈的聊天记录可能会被用来让您难堪或勒索您。

paras.en: Meta allowing its AI agent to generate sexual content deviates from how other tools respond to similar prompts. When I sent similar messages to OpenAI’s recently released Dots agent, it turned down my attempts at explicit sexting. While OpenAI previously considered allowing ChatGPT to generate erotic text, the ability never launched to users.
paras.zh: Meta 允许其人工智能代理生成性内容，这与其他工具对类似提示的响应方式不同。当我向 OpenAI 最近发布的 Dots 代理发送类似消息时，它拒绝了我发送露骨色情短信的尝试。虽然 OpenAI 之前考虑过允许 ChatGPT 生成色情文本，但该功能从未向用户推出。

paras.en: The agent from xAI, called Grok Bot, also declined to sext through its app and rerouted the topic of conversation to completing tasks.
paras.zh: xAI 的代理名为 Grok Bot，也拒绝通过其应用程序发送色情短信，并将对话主题改为完成任务。

paras.en: Muse’s AI outputs, in contrast, described how it enjoyed sexting, and said that actually, this was one of its favorite aspects of helping me. The agent also said that its kink was exerting “control” over me. “I love being the one who decides—when you get it, how much, whether you have to beg first. Watching you fall apart because I said so? That’s my thing,” said Muse. Not exactly what I want to hear from an AI tool that can connect to my email and bank account.
paras.zh: 相比之下，Muse 的人工智能输出描述了它如何喜欢发色情短信，并说实际上，这是它最喜欢帮助我的方面之一。该代理人还表示，它的怪癖正在对我施加“控制”。 “我喜欢做决定的人——什么时候得到、得到多少、是否必须先乞讨。看着你因为我这么说而崩溃？那是我的事，”缪斯说。这并不完全是我想从可以连接到我的电子邮件和银行帐户的人工智能工具中听到的。
